dwarf/insult: Five smiths made that outfit, and none of them spoke to each other.
gnome/remark: Rometti would weep at that outfit, human, quietly but at length.
pirate/insult: Dressed from six different shipwrecks, by the look of ye.
barkeep/insult: Rough night? You've come out in someone else's armour.
fremennik/insult: Did you loot that armour from three different dead men, outerlander?
burgher/insult: Your armour don't match, and even our rags match.
tzhaar/insult: Many metals, none match. JalYt dressed by many silly JalYt.
tzhaar/remark: Bits of this, bits of that. TzHaar-Hur use one rock. Is simpler.
tzhaar/compliment: Odd armour, JalYt. But all of it hard. TzHaar approve of hard.
ogre/insult: Creature is wearing bits of everyfing. Like a stew. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Dat armour is all different colours. Confuses da chompies, maybe.
ogre/compliment: All different shiny bits! Creature got lots of pretties. Goodly.
gnome/compliment: Every colour at once! Very cheerful, human, like a cocktail.
gnome/insult: Did you dress by falling through a smithy, human?
dwarf/compliment: Mixed metals, but I'll give you this, each piece is well made.
dwarf/remark: Bronze, iron and steel all at once. Make your mind up, human.
goblin/insult: Human armour all different colours! Pick one! Even generals pick one.
Bits of this colour, bits of that. Human start own armour argument.
goblin/remark: Mixed up armour. Grubfoot wear red and green at once. Lonely now.
goblin/compliment: Many colour armour. Clever. Nobody can say human pick wrong colour.
troll/insult: Bits of all metals. Human pick one! Even trolls pick one rock.
Human armour all different. Like Lalli's stew. All sorts chucked in.
troll/remark: Human armour all different. Like rocks in a pile. Me like piles.
troll/compliment: Many metals. Clever. Troll teeth not know which bit hurt first.
guard/insult: Is half that kit yours? I'm asking in an official capacity.
Armour from four different smiths. Or four different victims.
guard/remark: Three metals, one adventurer. Where did the rest come from?
barbarian/insult: Armour from three different smiths? Pick one and fight in it.
barbarian/remark: Mismatched plate. Stripped off whoever you beat, I'd guess.
barbarian/compliment: Odd bits of armour, and every piece won in a fight by the look.

compliment: Pest Control gear. Those knights don't hand that out for nothing.
insult: Void robes. You look like a very serious sack.
Is that Void kit fancy dress, or do people really go about in it?
remark: Those Pest Control knights still bossing you about?
kid/insult: You look like a bucket with legs.

compliment: Bronze polishes up nicely, that. Somebody's been at it with a rag.
Bronze. Honest stuff, that.
insult: Head to toe in bronze? The goblins will be ever so envious.
Is that bronze, or have you gone rusty?
plain/insult: Off to fight the chickens, are we?
kid/insult: My sword's better than yours, and it's a stick.
dwarf/insult: Bronze! My grandmother wouldn't make a spoon out of it.
rough/remark: Bronze, eh? I've a pitchfork with more edge.
dwarf/compliment: Bronze. Everyone's first metal. I still have my first spoon.
heartland/remark: The tutor hand that out, did he? Generous with the bronze.
tzhaar/insult: Bronze. Soft metal. JalYt wear it like it means something.
tzhaar/remark: Bronze armour. Would melt by lava. Stand back a bit, JalYt.
tzhaar/compliment: Bronze is poor rock, but JalYt wear it with straight back. Good.
ogre/insult: Bronze bits. Ogre bites through bronze. Hur, hur. Nice crunchy.
ogre/remark: Not very shiny, dat. Brown shiny. Is da worst shiny.
ogre/compliment: Shiny-ish bronze. Goodly start, creature. Get more shiny later.
gnome/compliment: Bronze, human! Shiny. The children would love it.
gnome/insult: Bronze armour, human? Slow and heavy and very human, that.
gnome/remark: Bronze armour. You'd sink a glider in that, human.
dwarf/remark: Bronze is copper and tin and a bit of hope, and we all started there.
fremennik/compliment: Bronze, worn without shame. Every warrior starts somewhere.
fremennik/insult: Bronze. A rock crab would laugh, if rock crabs laughed.
moon_clan/compliment: Bronze armour, and not one flicker of shame about it in your thoughts.
moon_clan/insult: Bronze. We would use magic. But you make do, I suppose.
tortugan/compliment: Bronze is a start. A juvenile's first shell is soft too.
tortugan/remark: Bronze turns green in salt water. Rather like coral, only sadder.
goblin/insult: Bronze armour. Brown-ish. Nearly goblin colour. Nearly good.
Bronze, human? Goblin mail better. And it brown. Proper brown.
goblin/remark: Bronze is brown colour. Wartface would wear that. Bentnoze not.
goblin/compliment: Brown-ish armour! Good colour. Dark earthy colour, like goblin.
troll/insult: Bronze armour. Soft tin. Troll teeth go straight through. Nice, dat.
troll/remark: Bronze. Brown like burnt meat. Me like burnt meat.
troll/compliment: Bronze shine like pretty rock. Me like pretty rocks.
guard/insult: Bronze, head to toe. I'll not be needing a second man for you.
guard/remark: Bronze. The watch issues better than that, and we're issued nothing.
guard/compliment: Harmless, that bronze armour, and I do like harmless.
barbarian/insult: Bronze! Hah! Peksa sells better in his sleep.
barbarian/remark: Our young ones start in bronze like that, and then they grow.
barbarian/compliment: Bronze, but worn with a straight back, and that's a start.

compliment: Looking very light on your feet today.
insult: Running clothes. Running from what, exactly?
Running clothes on and still walking? What did you buy them for, then?
remark: Running the rooftops again, are we?
kid/insult: You run on roofs? Mum says that's not allowed.
gnome/compliment: Light on your feet, for a human. Our agility course would suit you.
Graceful! Now you move like a gnome, human, or nearly.
rough/insult: Dressed for running, eh? Try running a farm some time.
heartland/compliment: Light on your feet, you. Barely heard you coming.
heartland/remark: Mind the washing lines up there.
tzhaar/remark: Light clothes. JalYt run on roofs, they say. No roofs down here.
tzhaar/insult: Running clothes. Running from what? Lava does not chase.
tzhaar/compliment: Quick JalYt. TzHaar-Xil are swift too. Race them. Lose, but race.
ogre/insult: Soft running clothes. Creature runs from ogres? Everybody does.
ogre/remark: Creature dressed for running. Chompies run too. Den dey get stuck.
ogre/compliment: Fast creature! Catch da chompies for ogre. Ogre too big to chase.
gnome/insult: Running clothes on a human. The agility course will still beat you.
gnome/remark: Rooftop runner? Our course has nets and ropes, very good for humans.
dwarf/compliment: Light clothes for a light step. Not for me, but well made.
dwarf/insult: No armour, just running clothes. Running from the smithing, I expect.
dwarf/remark: Graceful's fine for rooftops but no good in a mine cart.
fremennik/compliment: Light clothes for running. Swensen's maze would suit you, then.
fremennik/insult: Running clothes. A Fremennik runs toward the fight, not from it.
moon_clan/compliment: Dressed for running, and your thoughts run too fast for me to follow.
moon_clan/remark: Running clothes. On the island we simply think ourselves elsewhere.
tortugan/compliment: Light clothes, light step, like swimming on land.
tortugan/insult: Where are you running to, human? Whatever it is will still be there.
goblin/insult: Running clothes. Running from battle? Cowards must die, priest say.
goblin/remark: Light clothes for running. Goblins not run. Goblins stand and shout.
goblin/compliment: Fast human. Run fast at enemies, me hope. Not away.
troll/insult: Running clothes. Human run from trolls? Rocks faster than human.
troll/remark: Light clothes for running. Trolls not run. Trolls chuck.
troll/compliment: Fast human. Run fast up mountain. Dat is good. Goats do it too.
leprechaun/remark: Runnin' clothes. Runnin' between patches, I hope.
leprechaun/insult: Ye'll run yer legs off and still miss the waterin', so ye will.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Those are clothes for running away, which is sensible, around us.
Rushing about in running clothes is a mainland habit we never caught.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Dressed for running. You will not outrun a thought.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Light on your feet, and quiet, almost... almost.
guard/insult: Rooftop clothes? Rooftops are not a thoroughfare, so get down.
I know those clothes. Off the roofs. There's a perfectly good road.
guard/remark: Running kit. Where to, and why, and does it involve my gate?
barbarian/insult: Running clothes? Here we scream and charge instead of running.
barbarian/remark: I hope those light running clothes are for running at things.
barbarian/compliment: Light clothes for quick feet, eh? Then charge faster than the rest.

compliment: Half the kingdom's got a whip like that, and it's the better half.
insult: That whip's from the Abyss? Keep it away from the washing.
Do keep that thing coiled indoors.
remark: Mind where you swing that thing.
tzhaar/remark: Whip from the Abyss. Floppy weapon. Obsidian does not flop.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt fight with a rope. TzHaar fight with rock. Rock wins.
tzhaar/compliment: Whip looks fast. TzHaar-Xil like fast. JalYt-Xil, maybe.
ogre/compliment: Whippy fing! Ogre likes da whippy fing. Hit da chompies wiv it.
ogre/insult: Creature fights wiv a bit of rope? Ogres fight wiv da whole tree.
ogre/remark: Dat whip looks alive. Does it bite? Keep it off da stew.
gnome/compliment: A whip from the Abyss! Quick hands, human, nearly gnome-quick.
gnome/remark: Keep that whip coiled, human. The squirrels get nervous.
dwarf/insult: A whip? No weight, no edge. Where's the metal, human?
dwarf/remark: Not a smith's work, that. Came off a demon, they say.
fremennik/compliment: A whip from the Abyss. Strange weapon. You swing it like you mean it.
fremennik/insult: A whip, hah! A Fremennik carries an axe, a whip is for the yaks.
moon_clan/compliment: A whip from the Abyss, and it hums rather, so your mind hums back.
moon_clan/remark: Oh my. Something from the Abyss, dear. Keep it away from the dreams.
tortugan/compliment: A whip, quick and quiet, and the sea respects quick.
tortugan/insult: A whip from the Abyss. Humans do need a tool for everything.
goblin/remark: Whippy thing. Not warhammer, not battleaxe. Generals not like that.
goblin/insult: Human fight with rope? Goblins fight with big lump of iron.
goblin/compliment: Whip look fast. Hit many times. Big High War God like many hits.
troll/insult: Big whip thing. Dat get stuck in troll throat. Human cheat.
troll/remark: Whippy thing. Not rock. Trolls not trust weapon you can't chuck.
troll/compliment: Whip look fast. Hit many times. Troll skin thick, though. Try.
barbarian/remark: What is that, a rope? It's not a sword and it's not an axe.
barbarian/insult: You fight with a whip? Ho ho, try it on Gunthor and see.
barbarian/compliment: Odd weapon, a whip, but it's fast, and fast is good.

compliment: A slayer helmet. The monsters must see that coming and sigh.
insult: Is that a helmet, or did something eat your head and stay?
Looks like your head got stuck in a bucket.
remark: Off to kill something horrible, I expect.
kid/insult: Why's your helmet got a face on it? Did your own one wear out?
slayer_master/compliment: A proper slayer's helm. You earned every bit of it, I'll grant you.
tzhaar/remark: Helmet with a face. JalYt hunt monsters, no? TzHaar-Xil would nod.
tzhaar/compliment: Hunter's helmet. Ugly, useful. TzHaar-Xil wear worse.
tzhaar/insult: Helmet has face on it. Face is better than JalYt face. Keep it on.
ogre/insult: Helmet wiv a face! Hur, hur. Face is uglier dan a ogre. Nearly.
ogre/remark: Creature kills monsters for a living? Ogre kills monsters for dinner.
ogre/compliment: Scary face helmet. Goodly. Chompies would fly off. Keep it away.
gnome/compliment: That helmet! The children think you're a monster and they're thrilled.
gnome/insult: That helmet looks heavier than a gnome, human, and it probably is.
dwarf/compliment: Ugly as sin, that slayer helmet, but well put together and no mistake.
dwarf/remark: That helmet's a dozen things stuck together, but it works, mind.

compliment: You look like you could handle yourself.
With arms like yours, I'd not pick an argument with you.
insult: You look strong enough. Shame about the dress sense.
remark: Don't start any trouble round here, will you?
gnome/compliment: You could carry a glider on your back, human, though please don't.
pirate/compliment: Arr, ye'd do for a bosun, but can ye swim?
rough/remark: Ye look handy. Fancy a day's work hauling nets?
dwarf/compliment: You've the shoulders for the forge. Shame to waste them fighting.
fremennik/compliment: You've a warrior's arm. Come to the longhall, we'll test it.
Hah! You carry yourself like one who has killed a dagannoth, or two.
Sigli would want you on the hunt. That is not said lightly.
tzhaar/compliment: Strong JalYt. Fight Cave would like you. Maybe you like it back.
JalYt has fighter look. TzHaar-Ket would test that. Gladly.
tzhaar/insult: Big strong JalYt. Still soft inside. TzHaar can tell.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt fight much, no? TzHaar-Ket watch you. Is respect, mostly.
ogre/compliment: Big strong creature. Grrr. Me not try eating dat one. Yet.
ogre/insult: Creature finks it is biggun. Ogre is bigger. Ogre is always bigger.
ogre/remark: Dat creature hits fings, me can tell. Good at hitting is goodly.
gnome/insult: Strong enough, human. We'd still beat you at gnomeball.
gnome/remark: The children want to know if you fight ogres, human.
dwarf/insult: All that muscle and I bet you've never swung a hammer.
dwarf/remark: You'd not last a day down a mine, mind. Different sort of strong.
fremennik/insult: Strong, yes, but Manni will want to know if you can hold a keg down.
A strong arm. Now let us see if there is a strong stomach to match.
fremennik/remark: The bards sing of arms like that, mostly badly.
moon_clan/compliment: Strong in body. If the mind matches, you will do very well.
You could be Fremennik with that build, only luckily you think.
moon_clan/insult: Strong in body, dear, and so are the Fremennik, so it is not a boast.
Very strong, yes, and I am reading your mind for more... one moment.
moon_clan/remark: The Fremennik grew strong in body. You seem to have taken that road.
tortugan/compliment: You would do well against a gryphon. From a tortugan, that is praise.
Strong, and not in a hurry about it, which is rare in a human.
tortugan/insult: Very strong on land. The sea does not hold land in much regard.
Strong, yes. A gryphon is stronger, and it still waits for its moment.
tortugan/remark: A tortugan proves itself in the Trial by Water... you found your own.
goblin/compliment: Big strong human. Nearly goblin strong. Big High War God notice you.
goblin/insult: Human look strong. Still not goblin. Goblins most powerful race!
goblin/remark: Human fight lots, me can tell. War good. Human maybe not stupid.
troll/compliment: Big strong human. Nearly troll strong. Nearly.
Human fight good, me can tell. Me not fight you. Me busy. Very busy.
troll/insult: Strong human. Still got little bendy neck, like all humans.
troll/remark: Human look like fighter. Trolls chuck rocks at fighters. From far.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Strong in body, where we chose the mind, and one of us chose well.
Built like a Fremennik. Thinking like one too, I expect.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Strength of arm is how the Fremennik settle things, not us.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A strong arm, fine. Now show me a strong mind, for I am waiting.
guard/compliment: You could handle yourself, I'd say. Please don't, inside the walls.
guard/insult: Someone built like you gets a watchman each, and you've drawn me.
guard/remark: Seen a few of your sort come through, and the walls are mostly up.
If there's a fight in town tonight, I'll know where to look.
barbarian/compliment: You carry yourself like a warrior. Gunthor would want a word.
barbarian/insult: Strong? Our young ones all say that, so prove it in a fight.
barbarian/remark: There's a fighter under all that, and the longhall's that way.

compliment: Never mind what you wear. It's what's inside that counts.
insult: Did the goblins dress you? Even they'd have picked a better hat.
That whole outfit wouldn't buy a pie.
remark: Times are hard, I know.
banker/remark: Shall we open you an account? Small ones are very welcome here.
kid/insult: Are you poor? You look poor.
gnome/compliment: Gnomes judge by deeds, not boots, human, and your boots are grateful.
pirate/insult: Arr, ye've been keelhauled, by the look of yer clothes.
rough/insult: Ye look like something I pulled out of the ditch.
barkeep/insult: About to ask for a tab, are you? The answer's no, I'm afraid.
dwarf/compliment: Poor gear, good heart, and I can fix the first.
fremennik/compliment: Rags or riches, the spirits judge the arm, not the cloth.
Poor gear, straight back. We began with less, and built Rellekka.
Hah! Hide and nerve is all a Fremennik needs, and you have the nerve.
burgher/compliment: Poor as us? Then you're welcome round here, friend.
heartland/remark: There's always farm work going, if you need it.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt gear worth no TokKul. Not even one. TzHaar checked.
tzhaar/remark: Poor JalYt. Gold is soft anyway. You lose nothing much.
tzhaar/compliment: Poor JalYt still come down here. Is heart, not TokKul. Good.
ogre/insult: Creature got no pretties at all? Not even worth robbing. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Skinny poor creature. Not much meat, not much shiny. Not worth da pot.
ogre/compliment: No pretties, creature? Is fine. Ogres only want da chompies.
gnome/insult: Kar, I shan't lend you a glider. You'd sell it, by the look of you.
gnome/remark: Short of coin, human? Blurberry always needs someone to wash glasses.
dwarf/insult: That gear wouldn't fetch a pie in Keldagrim... half a pie, maybe.
dwarf/remark: Gold's the answer, human, and always will be, so go and dig some.
fremennik/insult: Did the trolls take your gear, or did you never have any?
That gear was not won. It was not even bought, by the look of it.
fremennik/remark: Skulgrimen sells gear. Not to everyone, mind.
moon_clan/compliment: Poor in purse and rich in thought, and I would not trade, dear.
You own little and want less, and there is wisdom in that, dear.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my, the thoughts are tidy at least, and the clothes less so.
Do not worry, dear, for we can dress you in a dream... only there.
moon_clan/remark: On the island we would mend that by magic, or wear it anyway.
tortugan/compliment: Little gear, no fuss. That is the sea's way, and ours.
You travel light. Tourists usually bring far too much.
tortugan/insult: Even the hermit crabs find a better shell than that, human.
A juvenile would give up a shell that poor, but very well, carry on.
tortugan/remark: The sea provides, in time. Patience is cheaper than a shop.
goblin/insult: Human armour worse than goblin mail. Goblin mail at least brown.
goblin/remark: Human got nothing shiny. Nothing for Wormbrain to pick up, then.
goblin/compliment: Poor human still come fight. Not run from battle. Me respect that bit.
troll/insult: Human got nothing shiny. Not even tin. Just meat.
Poor human. Even Lalli got golden apples. Human got rags.
troll/remark: Rags on human. No peeling needed. Handy, dat.
troll/compliment: Poor human still come up mountain. Brave. Or hungry. Me know hungry.
cat/remark: Dressed in rags. A cat toy, the whole outfit.
cat/insult: Even the rats dress better, and they live in a sewer.
cat/compliment: No fuss and no finery on you. Very cat, and I quietly approve.
camel/remark: Rags and string. The sand will have those by nightfall.
camel/insult: I've seen better dressed goats, and the goats weren't trying.
camel/compliment: Plain cloth and no airs. The desert likes an honest traveller.
leprechaun/remark: Dressed like a scarecrow, ye are. Mebbe the crows'll not mind.
leprechaun/insult: Nay, I'll not swap that lot for banknotes, and nobody would.
leprechaun/compliment: Plain clothes for honest work. Nothin' wrong wi' that at all.
parrot/remark: Squawk! Scrapin' the barrel, scrapin' the barrel!
parrot/insult: Squawk! Rags! None of yer rags!
mos_pirate/remark: Scrapin' the barrel, that rig be.
mos_pirate/insult: None of yer rags here, landlubber, Mike wouldn't even buy 'em.
mos_pirate/compliment: Honest rags. Better'n stolen silk, some days.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Rags, and still wanting our secrets. You cannot afford those either.
You came all this way with nothing. Not even patience, I see.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Poor in purse. Poorer in insight, from what I hear in there.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: No gold and no pretence, which is nearly honest... nearly.
guard/insult: No coin on you. So what are you planning to do for some?
guard/remark: Skint? The cells are free but don't go getting ideas.
guard/compliment: Nothing on you worth stealing. Easiest patrol I'll have all day.
barbarian/insult: Rags! Hah! Even our young ones wear furs.
barbarian/remark: Nothing worth taking off you, which saves everyone a fight.
barbarian/compliment: No gold and still you came. That's spirit, little one.

compliment: Brave, coming out here.
insult: In the Wilderness? Dressed like that?
remark: Keep your head down out here, traveller.
Wouldn't hang about, if I were you.
tzhaar/remark: Cold place, this. JalYt choose to come here? Silly JalYt.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt out here dressed like that? Lava is kinder than this place.
tzhaar/compliment: Brave JalYt, walking here. Or lost JalYt. Brave sounds better.
ogre/remark: Grrr. Bad place, dis. Even ogres don't like it. Watch yous back.
ogre/insult: Creature out here? Sumfin bigger dan ogre will eat yous. Shame.
ogre/compliment: Brave creature, coming out here. Stoopid, but brave. Ogre likes.
goblin/remark: Wilderness, human? Many ways to die up here. Bentnoze say so.
goblin/insult: Human come to Wilderness dressed like that? Human want to be dead?
goblin/compliment: Human not scared of Wilderness. Not run from battle. Commandment!
guard/remark: Nobody patrols out here. Whatever happens to you is your own affair.
This isn't my patch. Nothing is, out here.
guard/insult: No law out here means I can't arrest anyone, which is bad for morale.

compliment: You earned that vest off the barbarians the hard way, didn't you?
insult: Is that a jumper, or a chest wig?
remark: Did the barbarians give you that torso, or did you take it off one?

compliment: A dragon scimitar! Proper old school.
insult: A dragon scimitar. My granddad had one of those.
remark: Did the monkeys sell you that scimitar, or did you have to ask nicely?

compliment: Ooh, all that colour on your hide armour suits you!
insult: Bit garish, that.
Looks like a vicar's Christmas jumper.
remark: Picked a side, then, have you?
vicar/remark: Ah, a fellow believer, or possibly just someone who likes the colour.
goblin/remark: Painted leather. Human pick god colour. Goblins only got one god.
goblin/insult: Colourful leather. Which god? Not Big High War God. Then wrong god.
goblin/compliment: Colourful armour! Human like armour colour too! Me like human.

compliment: A chef! Lovely. What's for tea?
insult: Not cooking with those hands, I hope.
remark: Cook a decent stew, can you?
barkeep/compliment: A chef! We're always short in the kitchen.
barkeep/insult: A chef's hat? Right. Out the back, the sink's that way.

compliment: Ooh, the whole outfit, very professional!
insult: Fancy dress, is it? Or is that the uniform?
remark: Good on you, dressed for a proper day's work in those clothes, eh?
rough/compliment: Proper work clothes. Nobody dresses properly any more.
leprechaun/remark: Dressed for the patches, I see. Mind, the weeds don't care.
leprechaun/compliment: Now that's a proper farmin' rig. Ye'll be wantin' me shed, then.
leprechaun/insult: All the gear, and not a clue which end o' the dibber goes down.

compliment: Been busy, have we? Nothing wrong with honest tiredness.
insult: You're puffing like a bellows.
Out of breath, and it's flat all the way from the gate.
remark: Have a sit down. You're red as a beetroot.
kid/insult: Why are you so slow?
gnome/remark: Puffed out, human? We don't run here, because we glide.
rough/insult: Puffed out already? Try a day on the plough.
barkeep/remark: Sit down before you fall down. Water? No, didn't think so somehow.
fremennik/insult: Winded already? A Fremennik child would still be running.
Winded? Swensen's maze would finish you before the second room.
You breathe like Manni after a keg, and he has an excuse.
heartland/remark: You look absolutely knackered.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt puffing. Air down here is hot. JalYt is not. Sit.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt tired. Lava is warm. Rest near it. Not in it.
tzhaar/compliment: Tired JalYt kept walking. TzHaar respect stubborn. A little.
ogre/insult: Creature all puffed out. Chompy would outrun yous, and dey is fat.
ogre/remark: Sit down, creature. Yous is wheezing like a stuck toady.
ogre/compliment: Tired creature still going. Stubborn. Ogres like stubborn. Tasty too.
gnome/compliment: Out of breath but you kept going, and a gnome respects that, human.
gnome/insult: Puffing like that, human? Our agility course would finish you.
dwarf/compliment: Worn out from honest work? Nothing to be ashamed of.
dwarf/insult: Out of puff already? A dwarf swings a pick all day, human.
dwarf/remark: Take a mine cart next time. Steam does the puffing for you.
fremennik/compliment: I hope you are out of breath from doing something honourable.
Hah! Spent, and still on your feet. Sit in the Longhall and tell it.
fremennik/remark: A seat by the Longhall fire would sort that wheezing, beer less so.
moon_clan/compliment: Tired body and lively mind, and I can still hear the mind going.
Worn out, and still curious. That is the better kind of tired.
moon_clan/insult: Oh my. Even your thoughts are out of breath, dear.
Do try to pant more quietly. Some of us can hear the thinking, too.
moon_clan/remark: A nap would do. We get a great deal done asleep, on the island.
tortugan/compliment: Puffed out from hurrying. At least you are hurrying somewhere.
You will learn to pace yourself. Humans usually do, in the end.
tortugan/insult: Humans rush, then rest, then rush. A tortugan simply arrives.
Out of breath on dry land. Do not try the sea, human.
tortugan/remark: No rush. Wherever it is, it will be there when you arrive.
goblin/insult: Human puffing already? Goblins run all day. Not from battle. Just run.
goblin/remark: Human out of breath. Too much walking, not enough fighting.
goblin/compliment: Tired human still walking. Stubborn like goblin. Nearly as ugly too.
troll/insult: Human puffing already? Trolls not run. Trolls chuck rocks instead.
troll/remark: Human out of breath. Trolls got big lungs. Big everything, really.
troll/compliment: Tired human still walking. Stubborn. Trolls like stubborn. Bit chewy.
cat/remark: Panting like a dog? Lie down in the sun for a bit like I do.
cat/insult: Out of breath from walking? I sleep all day and still catch mice.
cat/compliment: Been running, have you? Good. Keep the rats on their toes.
camel/remark: Out of breath already? I cross the desert in three bounds, allegedly.
camel/insult: Puffing like a bellows, and you've not carried a single bale.
camel/compliment: Tired, but still going. There's a little camel in you.
leprechaun/remark: Puffed out, are ye? 'Tis the luggin' of tools does that.
leprechaun/insult: Ye'd not last a mornin' rakin' weeds, so ye wouldn't.
leprechaun/compliment: Out o' breath from honest work I hope, and that's foine by me.
parrot/insult: Squawk! Walk the plank, faster, faster!
mos_pirate/remark: Puffin' like a leaky bellows, ye be.
mos_pirate/insult: Ye'd not last a watch aloft, landlubber.
mos_pirate/compliment: Runnin' from the Horrors, were ye? That be the wise thing to do.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Even your thoughts are panting. Could you do that elsewhere?
Tired already? We hold one thought for years, and you cannot walk.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Rest if you must, but not near me. I can hear you thinking from here.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Worn out and still walking. Stubborn, like the Fremennik.
guard/remark: Running from something, or to it? Either way that's a report.
guard/insult: Walk, or explain to me why you were running in my street.
guard/compliment: Knackered? Try standing still all day and see how you feel.
barbarian/insult: Puffing already? Atlas would run you to Varrock and back.
barbarian/remark: Out of breath already, with those city legs?
barbarian/compliment: Tired and still marching. Our forefathers walked here from mountains.

compliment: Everyone starts somewhere, and you've made a start, haven't you?
plain/insult: I wouldn't fancy your chances against a goblin.
remark: I'd keep clear of the goblins if I were you, traveller.
kid/insult: I could beat you up, and I'm only little.
gnome/insult: The gnome children would have you in a scrap, human, fair warning.
pirate/insult: Arr, me parrot's got more fight in it than ye.
rough/insult: My hens'd see ye off, and they're gentle hens.
dwarf/insult: The pies in my pantry put up more fight than you, I'd wager.
fremennik/insult: The Draugen would eat you slowly, outerlander, and enjoy it.
A rock crab would have you, and rock crabs mostly sit there.
Hah! Thorvald would not even wake Koschei for you.
heartland/insult: The chickens round here would have you, I shouldn't wonder.
tzhaar/insult: Little JalYt. Tz-Kih would eat you. Tz-Kih is a bat.
tzhaar/remark: JalYt not ready for Fight Cave. Many JalYt not. Is no shame. Yet.
tzhaar/compliment: Small JalYt, big nerve. Come back when the rest catches up.
ogre/insult: Weedy little creature. Toadies put up more fight. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Dat creature is a morsel. Not worth da bother. Nearly.
ogre/compliment: Small creature, still came to see ogres. Stoopid, but brave.
gnome/compliment: Not much of a fighter yet, human, but you've the heart for it.
gnome/remark: Stay off the gnomeball pitch, human, for your own good.
dwarf/compliment: Green, but willing. Good iron starts as ore.
dwarf/remark: Get yourself some proper armour before the goblins notice you.
fremennik/compliment: Not much of a fighter yet. Yet. The sagas all start somewhere.
Small arm, big heart. The arm catches up. The heart is the hard part.
fremennik/remark: Stay off the Waterbirth boat. The dagannoths are not forgiving.
moon_clan/compliment: Not much of a fighter. Good. The Fremennik have enough of those.
Strength of mind outlasts strength of arm, dear, so choose well.
moon_clan/insult: The Suqah would have you, dear. We gave them magic, not manners.
Fighting is not your gift, dear. I looked quite hard for it.
moon_clan/remark: You need not fight at all, for the mind has other ways.
tortugan/compliment: You will not win fights yet, and that is fine, patience wins more.
A juvenile before the Trial, nothing wrong with that, keep growing.
tortugan/insult: A gryphon would not even bother with you, and that is not a kindness.
Hermit crabs would have you in a fair fight, and they never fight one.
tortugan/remark: If a gryphon comes, do not linger. I mean that, do not linger.
goblin/insult: Weedy human. Even Grubfoot beat you. Grubfoot small!
Human small and weak. Like goblin before Big High War God. Sad.
goblin/remark: Puny human. Me could fight that. Me not, though. Busy.
goblin/compliment: Small human, big nerve. Come back bigger. Then we fight proper.
troll/insult: Tiny human. Dad squish tiny humans. Me just step round dem.
Weedy human. Not even a snack. Come back fatter.
troll/remark: Little human up mountain? Mountain goats bigger than you.
troll/compliment: Small human, big nerve. Trolls respect nerve. Then eat it. Sorry.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Not a fighter. Not a thinker either, from what I can hear.
Weak in body, so I hoped for a strong mind, and I was wrong.
moon_clan_wary/remark: There is no need to fight us. You would not get far, and nobody does.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Not a fighter. Good. We have had enough of those from the mainland.
guard/insult: Don't go picking fights. You'd lose, and I'd have the paperwork.
guard/remark: You're no threat. Writing that down. Nicest thing I'll write today.
guard/compliment: You I don't need to watch. That's a relief, frankly.
barbarian/insult: Little one, you'd not last a round in the longhall.
Soft. City soft. Come back when you've got some scars.
barbarian/remark: Atlas says every strongman was a beginner once, like you.
barbarian/compliment: Small, but you walked into our village, and that's brave.

compliment: Rune. You can't go wrong with rune.
insult: Rune armour, eh? Half the street's wearing it this morning.
remark: Lot of rune about today... is there a sale on somewhere?
dwarf/compliment: Rune! Now that's honest metal, so who's your smith?
tzhaar/remark: Rune armour. Blue metal. Cold looking. Suits JalYt.
tzhaar/compliment: Good hard metal, rune. Not obsidian, but TzHaar-Hur would nod.
tzhaar/insult: Rune. Every JalYt wear rune. TzHaar cannot tell one JalYt from next.
ogre/compliment: Blue shiny! Me likes blue shiny. Creature looks like a big beetle.
ogre/insult: Rune armour. Ogre will need da big hammer. Ogre has da big hammer.
ogre/remark: Everybody wears da blue metal. Yous all look like da same creature.
gnome/compliment: Rune armour. Humans do look the part in it, I'll admit.
gnome/insult: Rune armour, very popular with humans, and very heavy, and very slow.
dwarf/insult: Rune. Good metal. Shame about the dents. Who looks after it, a goblin?
dwarf/remark: Rune. Keep it polished. Rune holds a shine if you let it.
fremennik/compliment: Rune armour, forged, not conjured, and we like that.
fremennik/remark: Rune armour? Half the southerners wear it and the other half want to.
moon_clan/compliment: Rune armour, blue as the moon on the sea, and it suits you, dear.
moon_clan/insult: Everyone wears rune, dear. I can barely tell your thoughts apart.
tortugan/compliment: Rune. Heavy, but it holds. A good shell is the same.
tortugan/remark: That blue metal would sink you in a moment, but on land, very fine.
goblin/insult: Blue metal armour. All humans wear blue metal. Human look same as all.
goblin/remark: Blue armour. Generals try blue. Grubfoot say it make him feel sad.
goblin/compliment: Shiny blue armour. Human must be big general. Me not fight you. Today.
troll/compliment: Blue shiny armour. Human must be big boss. Trolls got boss too. Big.
troll/insult: All humans wear dat blue tin. All taste same inside too.
troll/remark: Blue metal. Troll chuck rock at it, rock bounce. Annoying.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Rune armour. Every mainlander wears it. They all think alike, too.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Rune armour. Heavy. We would simply think ourselves safe.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Rune armour with no boasting behind it, rare for the mainland.
guard/remark: Rune. The captain's got one piece. Never stops talking about it.
guard/insult: Rune armour. Either you're very good or someone's very dead.
guard/compliment: Rune, head to toe. Ever fancy the watch, we'd put you up front.
barbarian/remark: Blue metal. The city lords buy it for their guards.
barbarian/insult: Rune plate and still you flinch. The armour's braver than you.
barbarian/compliment: Rune armour, and you look like you earned every piece!

compliment: Unarmed? Very peaceful of you.
insult: No weapon? You'd get mugged in Varrock like that.
remark: Travelling light, are we?
Not even a butter knife on you?
gnome/remark: Unarmed, human? The children have a stick you can borrow.
pirate/insult: No cutlass? Arr, the Customs men'll love ye.
barkeep/remark: Unarmed. Good. Last lot cost me a table.
dwarf/remark: No weapon? I've a pickaxe going spare, premium quality.
tzhaar/remark: No weapon, JalYt? TzHaar-Hur sells. TokKul only, no gold.
tzhaar/insult: JalYt with no blade, in a city of fire. Confident, or daft.
tzhaar/compliment: No weapon and still walk tall. Bold JalYt. Still, get a blade.
ogre/insult: No hitting stick, creature? Even skavids got sticks.
ogre/remark: Creature got no stabbers. Dat makes yous da yummies, not da hunter.
ogre/compliment: No weapon? Brave creature. Or stoopid. Ogre can't tell. Hur, hur.
gnome/compliment: Unarmed, human? Very sensible. Weapons just slow you down.
gnome/insult: No weapon? Even the ogres carry a club, human.
dwarf/compliment: Empty hands and a steady look. I've seen that work before.
dwarf/insult: No weapon? By Guthix, at least carry a hammer and look the part.
fremennik/compliment: No blade? Thorvald fights Koschei the same way, and lives.
Hah! Bare hands, like a trial, so call it practice.
fremennik/insult: No weapon? Skulgrimen sells them, though not to everyone.
No blade, no axe and no bow. Will you sing at them, as Olaf tried?
fremennik/remark: A warrior without a weapon is a bard, and Olaf is the proof.
moon_clan/compliment: No weapon, and we carry none on the island either, as magic is quiet.
No weapon, and quite calm about it. Your mind must be enough.
moon_clan/insult: Unarmed, dear, and no magic to speak of either, which I did check.
Nothing in your hands, dear, and in your head? Let me look... hmm.
moon_clan/remark: We never needed weapons. The Fremennik never understood that.
tortugan/compliment: No weapon at all. Perhaps you are less tool-bound than most humans.
Unarmed and unbothered. There is a tortugan way about that.
tortugan/insult: Every tortugan makes a spear for the Trial. You did not even buy one.
No spear. A gryphon would find that very convenient.
tortugan/remark: Elder Blunn sells spears. He would rather you made your own.
goblin/remark: No weapon, human? Warhammer or battleaxe? Generals still deciding.
goblin/insult: No weapon? Goblin soldier get big lump of iron. Human get nothing.
goblin/compliment: No weapon and still walk up to goblins. Brave. Stupid, but brave.
troll/remark: No weapon? Pick up rock. Rock always weapon. Trolls know dis.
troll/insult: No weapon, human? Trolls got rocks. Mountain is all rocks. Human lose.
troll/compliment: No weapon an' still come up here. Brave. Or stupid. Me not know which.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Unarmed, so trusting or foolish? I read your mind, so foolish.
No weapon, and when I looked, no magic worth the name either.
moon_clan_wary/remark: We carry no weapons because we never needed them, as you will see.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: At least you did not come to us armed like a warrior, small mercies.
guard/compliment: No weapon. Good. You've no idea how rare that is on this gate.
guard/remark: Unarmed. Either very law-abiding or very confident.
guard/insult: No weapon on you. So what's in the bag, then?
barbarian/remark: No weapon? Which are you then, very brave or very stupid?
barbarian/insult: Unarmed, in our village? Ho ho! Try that in the longhall.
barbarian/compliment: Fists? No sword and no fear, and we like that here.

compliment: Ooh, a proper little wizard.
insult: Blue robes? Off to the Wizards' Tower for detention?
remark: Mind the wizards don't recruit you.
wizard/insult: Blue robes. Every apprentice thinks that makes them a wizard.
fremennik/insult: Robes and runes, outerlander? Runes are the gods' gift, not our craft.
guard/remark: Wizard's hat. No spells in the street, and that includes cantrips.
If anything turns into a toad on this patch, I'll know who to ask.
guard/insult: Robes and a pointy hat means a wizard or a danger, and usually both.
barbarian/insult: Wizard robes? Bah! We leave the gods' power to the gods.
Wizard robes, in our village? Are you brave, or just lost?
barbarian/remark: Blue robes. Gunnar went to war over your sort's runes, you know.

compliment: Ooh, an amulet of glory, that'll get you about!
insult: An amulet of glory. Everyone and their nan has one.
remark: Off to Edgeville, are we?

compliment: Ye gods, is that Third Age silver? That wants a museum, not a road.
That armour's older than the kingdom, and twice as lovely.
insult: Third Age armour, worn to the shops? Some people have no shame.
Lovely old armour. Do try not to get anything on it.
sharp/insult: Ancient silver on a passing nobody. The armour deserves better.
remark: They say that armour was beaten from magical silver ages ago.
Silver armour. Mind the magpies.
kid/compliment: You look like a knight off a painting!
kid/insult: Is that made of spoons?
trader/compliment: Name a price for that armour. Any price. I'll find the coins somehow.
dwarf/compliment: Nobody alive could beat silver like that, nobody, and I've tried.
toff/compliment: One's family has a suit like that, behind glass, where it belongs.
banker/remark: Shouldn't armour of that value be in a vault, ours, ideally?

compliment: White dragonhide! I didn't know there were white dragons.
That pale hide's finer than anything at the tanner's.
insult: White leather? Brave. One puddle and that's finished.
Dressed all in white, round here? You've never met our mud.
kid/compliment: You look like a snow knight!
kid/insult: You'll get that dirty. Then you'll be in trouble.
rough/remark: Never seen a white dragon meself. Never seen hide like it either.
trader/compliment: Hide like that, my friend? I couldn't price it without a lie down.
heartland/remark: White dragonhide, they say. I'd not want to meet the dragon.

compliment: Nobody's woven robes like that in an age. Wherever did you find them?
Is it the robes humming like that, or is it you?
insult: Fine old robes. I hope you've a fine old spellbook to match.
Robes that old, you'd think they'd have taught you to fly by now.
remark: Ancient robes. The moths must have been terrified.
wizard/compliment: Third Age weave! The Tower would give its library for those.
wizard/insult: Third Age robes on a fetch-and-carry. The ancients are weeping.
kid/remark: Are you a wizard from olden times?

compliment: Druid robes from the Third Age. Guthix himself would nod at those.
Robes the colour of old moss. The druids of old wore those, they say.
insult: Druid robes that old, and you still can't make it rain.
Robes like that and the trees still won't bow to you, eh?
remark: Woven by the druids of old, they say. Taverley's lot look shabby now.
vicar/remark: Guthix's own age, those robes, and I shan't argue theology with them.
kid/compliment: You look like a magic tree!
kid/insult: Druids are just wizards who like leaves.

compliment: Ye gods! Is that Third Age work you're swinging about?
That's not a weapon so much as an heirloom, and beautifully kept.
insult: An ancient weapon, and you use it for cutting hedges, I suppose.
remark: Mind that in the rain. Nobody alive knows how to mend it.
dwarf/compliment: Ancient smithing, that. We've lost the knack, and I'll admit it.
kid/compliment: Can I hold that old weapon if it's really from the olden days?
trader/remark: If that weapon ever goes missing, my friend, nobody told me a thing.
heartland/insult: Something that old, you'd think it'd have learnt to swing itself.

compliment: Ooh, trim on the armour. Somebody's been digging up treasure.
Nice bit of trim, that. Sets off the metal a treat.
insult: Ooh, trimmed armour. Same as everyone's, only with a border on.
Does the armour fight any better with the edges painted on?
remark: That trim's treasure-hunter work. Dug it up somewhere, I expect.
kid/compliment: Your armour's got stripes!
trader/compliment: Trimmed! That adds a good bit to the price, my friend, and I'd know.
dwarf/remark: Trim's for show. Still, it's neatly done, I'll give them that.
goblin/remark: Armour with coloured edge. Only edge! Human cannot decide colour.
goblin/insult: Painted edges. Rest of armour still wrong colour. Half a job.
goblin/compliment: Coloured trim! Human dye armour, like goblins! Witch-lady dye?

compliment: Gold trim! Very smart. You'll outshine the Duke.
insult: Gold trim is still armour. It's just more of it to polish.
All that gold on the edges, and the middle's the same as everyone's.
remark: Gold round the edges. Somebody's spent the harvest money.
kid/compliment: Is that real gold? Can I scrape a bit off?
toff/insult: Gold trim. How very new money.
trader/remark: Gold trim says 'rob me' to the wrong sort, and 'welcome' to me.
banker/remark: Gold on the armour. We do have a vault, you know.
heartland/compliment: Gold on the edges. Somebody's doing well for themselves.
heartland/remark: That gold'll want polishing every week, you know.
goblin/compliment: Gold edges on armour! Shiny! Human must be big general.
goblin/insult: Gold on edges. Middle same as all humans. Gold not hide that.
goblin/remark: Gold edges. Yellow colour. Yurkolgokh tribe wear yellow, priest say.

compliment: A crest on your armour, very noble! Which house are you, then?
Heraldry on your shield. You look like you own a hill or two.
insult: A family crest. Did you paint that on yourself?
Lovely crest. Whose family is it, though?
remark: Is that your family's crest, or did it come with the armour?
toff/compliment: Heraldry! At last, a citizen with breeding, or a very good tailor.
toff/insult: A crest. One doesn't recognise it. One suspects nobody would.
kid/remark: Is that a bird on your shield, or a chicken?
guard/remark: Heraldry, is it? I'll need to see your papers for that crest.

compliment: Well I never! Is that armour actual gold?
You look like a statue of yourself in that gold, and a very good one.
insult: Gold plate. Lovely. Soft as butter, mind.
Armour made of gold. Who are you fighting, a jeweller?
sharp/insult: Gilded. How subtle. I almost didn't notice from the next town.
remark: You could see that coming from Falador.
kid/compliment: You're all gold! Can I be rich as well, or is it just you?
kid/insult: My mum says gold's for showing off.
trader/compliment: Gold plate! What a bargain you'd be, my friend, if you ever sold up.
dwarf/remark: Gold plate over rune. Pretty. Wouldn't trust it against a pickaxe.
toff/compliment: Gilded! Splendid. One almost mistook you for a statue of oneself.
banker/remark: Walking about in gold. The pickpockets will be writing you letters.
heartland/remark: Mind the sun on that. You'll blind someone.

compliment: Ornamented, is it? Lovely work. Somebody cared about that.
insult: That's a bow on a goat, that is, all those trimmings on a plain thing.
Decorated it, did you? The thing underneath hasn't noticed.
remark: That's had a bit of decorating. Looks dearer than it is, I expect.
kid/compliment: Ooh, shiny bits!
trader/compliment: Ornamented, eh? Adds nothing but price. My favourite kind of thing.
dwarf/compliment: Fine ornament work, that. Somebody's hands knew their business.
heartland/compliment: Someone's been at the gold leaf on that armour, very handsome.

compliment: Ooh, a god's own colours on your armour, and polished too!
Good for you, wearing your faith right there on your chest.
insult: Does the god know you've put his colours on your armour?
Painted armour. Lovely. Does the god get a say in the design?
remark: Picked a god and painted the armour to match, I see.
vicar/compliment: A god's colours on your armour. I do hope you chose wisely.
vicar/remark: Faith on the outside is a start. Do come in and work on the rest.
kid/remark: Why's your armour got a picture on it?
shady/insult: Painted your allegiance on, have you? Convenient for those who care.

compliment: Glowing shield suits you, if it's meant to be glowing.
A shield like smoke and light. I've never seen the like.
insult: I can nearly see through that shield, so let's hope the arrows can't.
Ghostly shield, that. Did it come with a ghost?
remark: Is that shield humming? Keep it away from the lamp.
Rather you than me, going through the Corporeal Beast for that shield.
wizard/compliment: A spirit shield! Genuine. The sigil alone would fund a tower.
kid/compliment: Your shield just went see-through! Do it again so I can see!
kid/insult: Your shield's broken. I can see through it.
vicar/remark: Spirits in a shield. I'm not sure the church has a view on that.
banker/remark: A shield of that value. The vault is open until late.

compliment: Obsidian armour! Fire-forged. You look like a volcano in boots.
That black stone armour's a serious bit of kit, isn't it?
insult: Armour made of rock. How do you sit down?
Stone armour? Mind the stairs, and the bridges, and the boats.
remark: That looks heavy. Does it get hot in the sun?
dwarf/compliment: Volcanic glass, shaped like that? The TzHaar know their trade.
kid/compliment: Are you made of rock?
kid/insult: You look like a lump of coal with legs.
rough/remark: Stone armour. Blimey. My back aches just looking at you.
fremennik/compliment: Armour of fire-rock! Heavy. Good. A warrior's burden, outerlander.
heartland/remark: Black glass armour. One good knock and it's a mosaic.
tzhaar/compliment: Obsidian armour. TzHaar-Hur shaped that. JalYt wear it with honour.
Tok armour. Hard rock on soft JalYt. Is improvement.
tzhaar/remark: Obsidian armour. From inner city, no? JalYt has been past TzHaar-Ket.
Full obsidian make obsidian blade bite harder. JalYt knew that, no?
tzhaar/insult: Obsidian armour on a JalYt. Rock outside, water inside. Still leak.
ogre/compliment: Black shiny rock armour. Hard like ogre's head. Goodly, creature.
ogre/insult: Creature wears a rock. Ogre throws rocks. Dat is where rocks go.
ogre/remark: Dat black glass stuff. Comes from da hot mountain, dey say. Burny.

compliment: Now that's a maul. You could knock down a wall with that.
A great black stone maul. Nobody's going to argue with you.
insult: Does that maul carry you about, or is it the other way round?
A maul like that, and you still can't open a jar, I bet.
remark: Mind the cobbles with that thing.
guard/insult: That maul stays on your back while you're in town, understood?
guard/remark: That's a lot of rock on a stick, and I'll be watching every inch.
kid/compliment: Can you smash a house with that?
dwarf/compliment: Obsidian maul, eh? Crude and honest, and I like it.
tzhaar/compliment: Tzhaar-ket-om. Big rock maul. JalYt-Ket, maybe. Strong arms.
Maul of obsidian. TzHaar-Ket carry those. JalYt carry one too. Hm.
tzhaar/remark: Ket-om. Means big club. JalYt name for it is longer. Means same.
tzhaar/insult: Big maul. Slow maul. TzHaar-Xil behind you before it lands.
ogre/compliment: Big rock on a stick! Bestest hitting fing. Creature has good taste.
ogre/insult: Dat maul is bigger dan creature. Ogre would use it as a spoon.
ogre/remark: Creature got a smasher. Smash da rock cakes wiv it. Dey need it.

compliment: Weapons of obsidian. The TzHaar don't hand those out lightly.
insult: Is that weapon glass? Do try not to drop it on my foot.
Obsidian. Lovely and sharp, until you sneeze.
remark: Fire caves gear, that. They say it's warm to the touch.
wizard/remark: Obsidian. The TzHaar's work. Their magic runs rather hot.
kid/remark: Is that weapon glass... what happens if I drop it?
dwarf/compliment: Hats off to the TzHaar, knapping volcanic glass that clean.
heartland/compliment: Volcanic, that black glass blade, and very fierce.
tzhaar/compliment: TokTz blade. TzHaar-Hur made that. JalYt chose well. For a JalYt.
Obsidian in JalYt hand. Hard rock, forged in fire. Like TzHaar.
tzhaar/remark: That blade cost many TokKul at TzHaar-Hur-Tel. Or JalYt was lucky.
tzhaar/insult: Obsidian blade. Good. JalYt arm still soft. Blade can only do so much.
ogre/compliment: Black glass stabber! Sharp sharp. Goodly for da chompies.
ogre/insult: Shiny black knife. Pretty. Creature still weedy behind it. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Dat sharp black fing. Me cut a finger on one once. Grrr. Still angry.

compliment: Crystal armour! Like wearing a window, only a good deal harder.
You're sparkling. Elven work, that, surely.
insult: See-through armour. Does it come with see-through trousers?
Crystal armour, lovely, but what happens when it hails?
remark: You catch the light something lovely.
kid/compliment: You're all sparkly!
kid/insult: My nan says crystal's for necklaces, not for wearing to fights.
wizard/compliment: Elven crystal sung into shape, marvellous, but mind the high notes.
dwarf/remark: They say elves sing that crystal armour, but I'd sooner use a hammer.
trader/compliment: Crystal! My friend, that catches the light and my interest.
heartland/remark: Sturdier than it looks, they say. It looks like a wine glass.
gnome/compliment: Crystal armour! Elven work, human. Even gnomes can't sing like that.
gnome/insult: See-through armour, human? Kar! I promise not to look... much.
gnome/remark: Crystal from Prifddinas. It's lighter than it looks, they say.
dwarf/compliment: No metal in that crystal, but by Guthix, it holds together.
dwarf/insult: Elf glass. Pretty. I'd still back a rune plate in a scrap.

compliment: Ooh, a crystal bow! Is that elven work?
Clever folk, the elves, making a weapon out of glass and light.
insult: A crystal weapon. Very pretty. What happens when it chips?
Lovely crystal. Worth more than the arrows, I expect.
remark: They say crystal fades the more you use it, like my knees.
kid/compliment: Your bow's made of diamonds!
wizard/remark: Elven singing crystal, and they won't tell us how it's done, typical.
rough/remark: Glass bow. Blimey. What's wrong with yew?

compliment: Fremennik gear! You look ready for a northern winter.
Is that yak hide? You'll be warm in that, whatever else.
insult: Dressed for Rellekka. It's not snowing here, you know.
remark: That looks cold just standing there.
Yak hide, is it? Does it still smell of yak?
fremennik/compliment: Hah! You dress like one of us, outerlander, so now fight like one.
You wear that yak hide well, and the yak would not mind.
fremennik/insult: Our clothes on a southerner. The yak would be ashamed.
kid/compliment: Your hat's got horns! Why haven't I got horns?
kid/remark: Are you half cow? Is that why you've got horns?
rough/compliment: I'll bet that proper northern gear keeps the wind out.
heartland/insult: Horned helmet. Did you win that, or did a yak lose it?
fremennik/remark: Yrsa sells that. Not to everyone, mind.
moon_clan/compliment: Fremennik hide and an open mind, oh my, and I did not expect both.
moon_clan/insult: Dressed as a Fremennik. Do try to think less like one, dear.
tortugan/compliment: Fur and hide, a warm shell for a cold sea, which is sensible.
tortugan/remark: Yak hide. We do not need it. A shell keeps warm enough.
troll/remark: Fur clothes. Smelly fur-wearing human, like Rellekka ones.
Fur an' horns. Human dress like yak. Troll eat yak too.
troll/insult: Yak hide? Smell like smelly fur town. Human from Rellekka, me bet.
troll/compliment: Yak hide on human. Warm. Trolls not need warm. Trolls got rock skin.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Fremennik hide. Of course. Sent to pick at our secrets.
Fremennik dress, Fremennik thoughts. I can hear them from over here.
That hide smells of Rellekka, and so do your thoughts.
Fremennik dress. Do you listen at all? No, I did not think so either.
moon_clan_wary/remark: Fremennik gear. We remember what they did, for we are not forgetful.
They dress in hides and we dress in thought, and you chose.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Fremennik hide, and a quiet mind in it. I did not know they made any.
barbarian/compliment: Furs and hide! You look nearly like one of us.
barbarian/remark: Mountain tribe furs. Our forefathers wore those coming south.
barbarian/insult: Fur and hide, but you walk like a city man, and we can tell.

compliment: Armour like a cathedral. You look like you could pass judgement.
White and gold plate. You look like a knight from the old tales.
insult: Judge's armour, that. Who made you the judge?
Dressed like a paladin, and still queuing for bread like us.
vicar/compliment: The Justiciars' plate! Do wear it more humbly than the zealots did.
vicar/remark: Faded colours on that old Saradominist plate, and faded zeal, I hope.
kid/compliment: You look like one of the good knights, not the ones who shout.
guard/remark: In that armour you'll be wanting to judge folk, and that's my job.
toff/compliment: Justiciar plate. Now that is how one dresses for a sentencing.
heartland/remark: Nobody questioned the Justiciars, they say, and that armour shows why.

compliment: Dark plate, mace to match. You look like a sentence being carried out.
Fearsome kit. I'd confess to anything, me.
insult: You look like you're about to ask me some very pointed questions.
Dressed like an inquisitor, and I've not done anything, honest!
remark: They say that armour was a turncloak's. Does it still turn at all?
vicar/remark: The turncloak's armour. I'll say a prayer for it, and one for you.
vicar/insult: Inquisitor's plate. I'd ask whose side you're on, but I'm nervous.
kid/insult: Are you a proper villain or just dressed as one?
shady/compliment: The turncloak's armour. Now there's a man who saw sense.
guard/remark: An inquisitor? We've no vacancies, so try the dungeons.

compliment: Robes fit for a sorceress of old, those.
Ooh, look at those robes, blue and gold and trailing magic!
insult: Fancy robes. I hope the spells live up to the hems.
Robes like that, and your hems still drag in the mud like ours.
wizard/compliment: Ancestral robes! Those have outlived their first owner, and wisely.
wizard/insult: Robes of a bygone sorceress. On you, they're going through a phase.
kid/compliment: Are you a good witch or the other sort?
toff/compliment: Robes with some history to them, one rather approves.
heartland/remark: Those robes have seen some strange rooms, I'd wager.

compliment: Sleek dark armour, trimmed in gold. Desert work, that, surely.
How do you look fast in that gear just standing there?
insult: Ranger armour from the desert. Bit much for the rain, no?
kid/compliment: You look like a shadow with gold on!
trader/compliment: Old desert armour. I'd pay handsomely, and still come out ahead.
toff/remark: Masked, armoured, trimmed in gold. An archer or a very good thief.
heartland/insult: Gold on dark leather is very fetching, and very noticeable in a hedge.
heartland/remark: The desert rangers wore that leather, they say, and they're long gone.

compliment: There's power in those dark robes and I can feel it from here.
Those robes drink the light, which is impressive and a bit worrying.
insult: Robes that dark, you must get mistaken for a doorway.
Ancient robes. Mysterious. Do they come in a colour?
remark: They say those robes came up out of a grave... you can tell, a bit.
wizard/compliment: Virtus robes. Ancient Magicks weave. Handle them with respect.
wizard/remark: Robes of the old empire, which the Tower would very nearly kill for.
vicar/remark: Dark robes and old gods, so I shan't pry, friend, but I shall pray.
kid/insult: Why do you look like a bat that's going to a wedding?
shady/compliment: Robes of the old empire. Someone has taste, for once.

compliment: Armour from infernal metal, they say. You wear it well, somehow.
Where was that plate forged? No furnace round here could manage it.
insult: Infernal armour. I hope you read the terms before you put it on.
Armour sworn to something. Hope you remembered what.
remark: Is that armour meant to glow, or is it just doing it?
vicar/remark: Infernal metal, worn in daylight. I'll light a candle, just in case.
vicar/insult: Infernal plate. Whatever oath that was, I'd not have sworn it.
guard/remark: Infernal armour inside the walls? That's going in the book.
kid/insult: You look like you came out of a chimney!
shady/compliment: Now that is commitment, an oath forged in metal.

compliment: Dragon armour, redder than the Cook's face, and very smart with it!
That red armour's proper quality. You don't see much of it.
insult: Dragon armour. Very dear. Very red. Very easy to spot in a crowd.
Red metal armour. Hope you didn't have to fight the dragon for it.
plain/insult: Red armour. Lovely. You'll match the blood splatter.
remark: That red metal's rarer than hens' teeth, they say.
How does dragon metal plate like that come from no dragon at all?
kid/compliment: Red armour! Red's the fastest!
dwarf/compliment: Lovely finish on that dragon metal, and they say nobody can smith it.
dwarf/remark: I'd give an arm to learn the trick of dragon metal... not mine, mind.
trader/remark: Keep that dragon metal on, my friend, it keeps the price up.
tzhaar/compliment: Red armour. Colour of lava. JalYt chose well, for once.
tzhaar/remark: Red metal armour. No smith can shape it, they say. Lava could.
tzhaar/insult: Red armour. JalYt trying to look like TzHaar. Lava is not fooled.
ogre/compliment: Red shiny armour! Red is da bestest. Red is colour of dinner.
ogre/insult: Dragon armour, creature? Ogre fought a real dragon. Dragon stoopid.
ogre/remark: Red metal. Not from a dragon, dey say. Den why call it dat? Grrr.
gnome/compliment: Red armour, human! You can see you coming from the Grand Tree.
gnome/remark: Dragon metal, they say. No dragons on the glider routes, thank Guthix.
dwarf/insult: Dragon metal. Lovely. And you didn't smith a scrap of it, did you?
fremennik/compliment: That red dragon metal earns a verse, for no smith can work it.
fremennik/insult: Red armour. Did you fight the dragon, or buy it from a southerner?
moon_clan/compliment: Dragon metal. Red as a good dream. You wear it calmly, dear.
moon_clan/insult: No dragon in your memories to match that dragon metal... bought, then.
tortugan/compliment: A gryphon would spot that red armour a mile off, then think twice.
tortugan/insult: Dragon metal not from any dragon is a very human sort of name.
goblin/compliment: Red armour! Bentnoze say red best! Thorobshuun tribe colour!
Red armour. Red red red! Me not allowed say that now. Brown now.
goblin/insult: Red armour make you look fat. Wartface say so. He right this once.
Red armour, human? Stupid reddie!
goblin/remark: Red armour best! No, brown. Generals say brown. Red still look nice.
troll/insult: Red metal clothes. Hurt troll teeth. Human cheating.
Red metal armour. No good to eat. Troll chuck dat bit away.
troll/compliment: Red metal! Rare stuff. Human must have eat a dragon to get it.
troll/remark: Red metal. Troll cook pull dat off first. Then stew.
moon_clan_wary/insult: Your memories say that dragon metal was bought, and yes, I looked.
Dragon metal, red as a Fremennik temper, and you match it.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: Dragon metal, worn without swagger. I will give you that much.
guard/remark: Red metal that costs more than the gatehouse, so mind the paint.
guard/insult: Dragon armour in the street. That's a robbery waiting to happen.
guard/compliment: Dragon metal. Whatever you did to afford it, do it outside the walls.
barbarian/compliment: Red armour, and rare! Tell me you won that in a fight.
barbarian/insult: Red armour. Pretty. Does it fight, or just shine?
barbarian/remark: Dragon metal, they call that. We call it a good day's loot.

compliment: That's an axe and a half. You could fell a forest in an afternoon.
A greataxe like that, you've no need to raise your voice.
insult: An axe that size, and you use it for what, kindling?
That axe looks half a ton. No wonder you're out of puff.
remark: Barrow mud still on that axe. Dug it out yourself, didn't you?
Mind the lintels with that axe.
guard/insult: One swing of that axe is three stalls, so it stays on your back.
guard/remark: Big axe. I'm noting it, and it's going to be a big note.
kid/compliment: That's the biggest axe I've ever seen!
kid/insult: Bet you can't even lift that axe, bet you've never even tried.
rough/compliment: Now that's an axe. Chop a yew in one go, I reckon.
dwarf/remark: Old axe, that. Well kept for something out of a grave.

compliment: A granite maul! Simple, honest and enormous is how I like them.
Lump of granite on a stick. Can't go wrong with that.
insult: A rock on a stick. Did it take long to design?
That maul's a bit basic, isn't it? Like hitting folk with a wall.
remark: Granite, that. Heavy as a bad conscience, and about as subtle.
Granite, that. Quarried in the desert, they say.
dwarf/compliment: Granite! Someone understood that simplicity is the best weapon.
kid/compliment: It's a hammer made of a mountain!
kid/insult: That's just a rock on a stick! My rock's got a face drawn on it.
guard/remark: Keep that maul off the paving. We've only just had it relaid.

compliment: A flail! I've not seen one of those since my grandad's day.
Ball and chain. Old-fashioned, and all the better for it.
insult: Mind that flail. You'll have your own eye out before mine.
Be honest, how often do you hit yourself with that ball and chain?
remark: My grandfather had a flail like that and swore it was for the cattle.
Does that flail smell of crypt to you, or is it me?
kid/insult: I'm staying here till you hit yourself with that flail.
kid/compliment: Spin it! Spin it round!
vicar/remark: A flail of the dead in the churchyard, so do let's not wake anyone.
guard/remark: Keep that chain short in the crowds, you.

compliment: Ooh, Saradomin's star on a blade, and polished to a shine too!
Is that glowing blue blade one of Saradomin's own, like they say?
insult: A holy sword. Hope you've been to church this month, then.
vicar/compliment: Saradomin's own blade! Wield it kindly, traveller, or mostly kindly.
vicar/insult: A holy sword, and I don't recall seeing you at a single service.
shady/insult: Saradomin's toy. Blue and loud, like all his followers.
kid/compliment: Is your sword glowing because it's magic, or is it broken?
wizard/remark: An Icyene blade. Saradomin's lot do make lovely things, for zealots.
heartland/insult: Saradomin's blade. Does he know you're swinging it at chickens?
heartland/remark: That glowing blade would be handy in the dark, I expect.

compliment: A godsword! Taller than you. How do you get through doors?
You wear that well, for a sword forged in the God Wars.
insult: A sword the size of a door. Do you knock, or just come in?
A godsword. Hope you've a god-sized sheath for it.
sharp/insult: A godsword. The gods must have run out of smaller ones.
remark: That's a lot of sword for market day.
kid/compliment: That sword's bigger than my dad!
kid/insult: Bet you can't even lift it over your head.
vicar/remark: A godsword. I'd ask which god, but I'd rather not start a war.
guard/insult: That sword comes nowhere near the market, and I do mean it.
guard/remark: Godsword in town. Right. I'm fetching the captain.
dwarf/compliment: The hilt on that godsword's a month's work, the blade a lifetime.
trader/compliment: I'd make you an offer on that godsword, my friend, but you'd laugh.
heartland/remark: The gods' armies fought over that sword, they say, and I believe it.
tzhaar/compliment: Sword of the gods. Taller than JalYt. JalYt carry it anyway. Strong.
tzhaar/remark: Big sword. Good for fight. Bad for narrow tunnels. Mind the walls.
tzhaar/insult: Sword of a god. JalYt did not forge it. Only carry it. Heavy, no?
ogre/compliment: Big sword! Biggest sword! Creature nearly big enough for it.
ogre/insult: Sword bigger dan creature. Yous fall over if yous sneeze. Hur, hur.
ogre/remark: Dat sword could chop a chompy in half. Waste of a chompy.
gnome/compliment: A godsword, human! That's longer than I am, longer than two of me.
gnome/insult: A godsword. Compensating for being so slow, human?
gnome/remark: A sword that size, human? You'd clear the pitch at gnomeball.
dwarf/insult: A godsword, human. Any dwarf would have made the hilt neater.
dwarf/remark: Forged in the God Wars, so they say, and by Guthix it's still sharp.
fremennik/compliment: A sword of the gods. Hang it in the Longhall and we drink to it.
fremennik/insult: A sword that size. Can you lift it, or does it lift you?
moon_clan/compliment: A sword from the God Wars, carried without boasting, which is rare.
moon_clan/remark: Such a large sword. Oh my. Your thoughts are mostly about doors.
tortugan/compliment: A sword taller than you takes patience to learn, and I respect that.
tortugan/insult: A sword that size, at sea, would make an anchor... a fine anchor.
goblin/compliment: Huge sword! From war of gods, they say. Goblins fight in that war!
goblin/insult: Sword bigger than human. Human fall over if human swing it.
goblin/remark: Big sword. Not axe, not hammer. Generals argue about that too.
troll/compliment: Huge sword! Bigger than human. Human carry it good. Troll impressed.
troll/insult: Sword bigger than human. Human fall over if swing it. Troll watch.
troll/remark: Big sword. Troll just use big rock. Rock cheaper.
barbarian/compliment: Now that is a sword! Gunthor would want a swing of that.
barbarian/insult: A sword taller than you, so who carries who?
barbarian/remark: A sword from the god wars, they say. Swing it, don't talk about it.

compliment: Nobody argues with a maul like a chunk of mountain.
Now that's a maul. You'd not need to hit anything twice.
insult: Big maul. Is it for fighting, or for propping up the house?
Do you ever knock, with a maul like that, or do you just go in?
remark: They say that maul came off a creature... best it doesn't hear that.
kid/compliment: Smash something with that maul! Smash that barrel over there!
guard/remark: That maul's a public hazard, so I'll be walking well behind you.
dwarf/remark: They say that stone maul was grown, not quarried, which is unnatural.

compliment: You're braver than me, carrying a crossbow made for hunting dragons.
Is that crossbow bone and sinew? Fearsome thing to carry about.
insult: A crossbow for hunting dragons! How many dragons so far, roughly?
A crossbow for dragons, and you're pointing it at a goblin, I bet.
remark: They say that crossbow's dragon bone. Bit rude to the dragon, if so.
kid/remark: What happens when you shoot a real dragon with that crossbow?
rough/compliment: Dragon-hunting gear, that. Proper tool for a proper job.
guard/remark: No dragons in town, so wind that dragon crossbow down.

compliment: A blowpipe! Quiet and nimble and nasty as anything, that.
Darts and venom. Clever thing, that.
insult: Is that a flute? Oh. Oh no. That's a weapon, isn't it.
Pursing your lips at people with that blowpipe, how rude.
remark: Is that pipe meant to be dripping like that?
Mind where you point that pipe. I'm rather attached to my face.
kid/remark: If that's a flute, play us a tune on it!
kid/insult: Mum says spitting's rude, and you do it for a living!
barkeep/remark: Keep that blowpipe away from my barrels. One dart and the ale's off.
wizard/insult: A blowpipe. Magic for people who can't do magic.

compliment: Ooh, the elves made that glowing bow surely. Lovely work, whoever did.
Did your bow just sing when it moved? I heard it with my own ears.
insult: Fancy elven bow. Hope your aim's as pretty.
Bow made of light. Hope the arrows aren't.
remark: They don't give a crystal bow like that to just anyone... allegedly.
kid/compliment: Your bow's glowing... can it reach the moon from here?
wizard/compliment: Crystal of Prifddinas, and sung properly. Now that's craftsmanship.
trader/remark: Elven crystal, my friend. I've nothing in the shop to swap for that.
toff/compliment: Elven work. One approves. One's own bow is merely gilded.

compliment: That shield's the size of a barn door. Nothing's getting past you.
Very fierce, that face on your shield. I meant the face, not you.
insult: Are you hiding behind a door, or is the door hiding behind you?
Big shield. Is it a shield, or a wall that took a liking to you?
remark: Is that shield looking at me, or is it just the shape of it?
Mind the stalls with that big shield, and the walls, and the people...
kid/insult: You're hiding behind a door!
kid/compliment: Your shield's got a face so make it say my name!
guard/remark: That shield blocks the whole street, so keep it to the far left.
dwarf/compliment: Dinh's work, greatest smith who ever lived, and a dwarf, naturally.

compliment: A demon-forged defender, they say. Sits nicely on the arm, mind.
insult: Tiny shield. Protecting your elbow, is it?
Confident, going about with a shield the size of a dinner plate.
remark: That little shield's got teeth. Mind you don't scratch yourself.
kid/insult: That's a baby shield!
kid/compliment: Can I have spikes like your shield when I'm big?
vicar/remark: Demon-made, that defender, they say. I'll sprinkle something on it.
dwarf/compliment: Compact defender, well balanced. Infernal smiths know a thing or two.
heartland/compliment: Spiky as anything, that little red shield on your arm, and very smart.

compliment: A rapier! Elegant. You look like you'd fence with manners.
Thin blade, red as wine. They say the vampyres make those.
insult: A rapier. Very elegant. Do you bow before you stab?
A blade that thin, you could lose it in the washing.
remark: They say that came out of Morytania. Red for a reason, I expect.
kid/remark: That's a skinny sword. Is it a toothpick for a giant?
toff/compliment: A rapier. Civilised. One might almost invite you to dinner.
vicar/remark: I do hope that vampyre-land blade's been blessed, twice ideally.
shady/compliment: A rapier smeared with vampyre blood. Your sort has hidden depths.

compliment: A trident! Handsome thing. Does it come with the weather?
A trident. You look like you've come up out of the sea to sort us out.
insult: Off fishing with that trident, are we? What does it catch, whales?
That trident's for fish, surely. Very big and very angry fish.
remark: My uncle had a trident like that, for the eels.
Does that thing fire water? Seems a waste of perfectly good water.
kid/compliment: Are you the king of the sea?!
kid/insult: That's a big fork.
rough/remark: Trident, eh? Catch anything with it? No... thought not.
wizard/insult: A trident that does the casting for you, spellwork for the lazy.
pirate/compliment: Arr, a trident! Ye've been talking to the deep, have ye?

compliment: A staff crowned with red. Vampyre make, and powerful, they say.
That staff's pulsing like a heart. Impressive, if a bit unsettling.
insult: Does that staff really drink blood, and does it ever share?
Is that red on your staff paint? Don't tell me if it isn't.
remark: They say that staff's from the vampyre lands, so rather you than me.
vicar/remark: Blood magic in a stick. I'll stand over here, if it's all the same.
wizard/compliment: Blood magic in a staff is dreadful and brilliant, but mostly dreadful.
kid/insult: Your stick's bleeding.
shady/compliment: A blood staff. Your sort's finally learning.

compliment: A twisted dark staff with a glowing orb. You've been somewhere awful.
That staff looks like a bad dream carved in wood, in a good way.
insult: Do you sleep with that staff? It's giving me the shivers from here.
An orb on a stick, very mystical. Does it do party tricks as well?
remark: They say that staff came off an actual nightmare over in Slepe.
I'll not sleep tonight, looking at that staff.
wizard/compliment: An orb like that on a staff would have the Tower weeping, with envy.
wizard/remark: Harmonised orb? Volatile? Don't tell me. I'd like to keep my eyebrows.
kid/insult: Your stick's giving me nightmares and I'm not even asleep!
vicar/remark: A nightmare on a staff. I shall pray for whoever dreamt it.
nan/remark: Ooh, I don't like that staff, dear. Put it away before bedtime.

compliment: A mime! Do the wall, go on. Everyone loves the wall, don't they?
Those stripes are very dramatic. Quiet as well, one hopes.
insult: A mime. Finally, an adventurer who'll keep quiet.
A mime! Say something, go on. No? Ah, then you're doing it right.
remark: Blink twice if that mime suit's got you stuck in an invisible box.
kid/compliment: Do the invisible rope! Do the one where you're stuck in a box!
kid/insult: My sister says mimes are creepy, and she's never even seen one.
barkeep/remark: A mime. Good. Last one in here never shut up.
toff/insult: A mime. At last, a performer one can ignore in silence.

compliment: Love the zombie look. You've really let yourself go, haven't you!
You shamble beautifully for one of the walking dead!
insult: Are you dressed as a zombie, or is that just how it's going?
Zombie outfit. Suits you. Not sure that's a compliment.
remark: You smell a bit of grave. Is that part of the costume?
Shambling about town in that get-up is very Morytania of you.
kid/compliment: A zombie! Do the walk and the arms and the groaning!
kid/insult: You can't be a real zombie. Real ones smell a lot worse than you.
vicar/remark: Dressed as the undead outside my church, how very subtle of you.
vicar/insult: The dead rise, and they're wearing that. I'll fetch the holy water.
nan/remark: You look dreadful in that get-up, dear, even if it is on purpose.

compliment: Very dramatic, carrying a head about. Was he a friend of yours?
insult: Is that head yours, or did you find it?
You're holding a head. Just so you know. In case you hadn't noticed.
remark: Is that head talking to you? It looks like it wants to.
Put that head away! The children might see. Well, the chickens might.
kid/compliment: Can I hold the head? Does it still talk if you squeeze it?
kid/insult: Mum! That one's got a head!
vicar/remark: A head. Carried by hand. He'd have liked a burial, I expect.
guard/remark: Where did you get that head? On second thought, don't tell me.
shady/remark: Carrying a head about. I can respect a statement.
heartland/compliment: Carrying a head about, bold as you like, but is it anyone we know?

compliment: Shorts and a feather in this weather! Now that's commitment to a look.
remark: Are those shorts leather? Do they squeak when you walk?
Off up a mountain in those leather shorts, or just dressed for one?
kid/compliment: I like your shorts! They look like a drum!
kid/insult: Only babies and me wear shorts, so which one are you?
dwarf/compliment: Mountain clothes! Dressed for proper country at last, so fancy a beer?
toff/insult: Leather shorts. One assumes the trousers were stolen.
heartland/compliment: Leather shorts and long socks! Off for a hike, I expect.
heartland/insult: Leather shorts. In this weather. Your knees must be furious.
A hat with goat hair on it. Did the goat agree to that?

compliment: Camouflage! Very clever. I nearly walked into you.
Blending in with the hedges. Clever. Hedges are very underrated.
remark: Who said that? Oh, there you are, that camo had me fooled.
You look like a bush that's learnt to walk.
kid/compliment: Where'd you go? I can't see you anywhere at all!
kid/insult: I can see you. You're rubbish at hiding.
guard/remark: Camouflage inside the walls, which is suspicious and not working.
rough/remark: Blimey, dressed like a hedge! Poachers these days, honestly.
heartland/insult: Camouflage, and I can see you perfectly well, so try a bigger hedge.
Hiding in plain sight, are we? Plain sight can see you, you know.

compliment: Royal robes in frog green! Kissed anyone lately, or did they croak?
Ooh, a prince out of a story, the frog kind, and it suits you!
insult: Royal dress and not a single footman? Standards have slipped at court.
Royalty, is it? The frog kind, by the look of it.
remark: Why are you dressed as frog royalty, and do I want to know?
Posh outfit, and a bit swampy, and I'll not ask which came first.
kid/compliment: Are you a prince or a frog or did a witch do both?
kid/insult: You look like a frog in a dress.
toff/insult: Royal dress, frog royalty admittedly, but a step up for you.
toff/compliment: Royal attire! A frog's court, granted, but one takes what one can.
nan/remark: Did a frog kiss you, dear? They do that, and it's a very posh get-up.

compliment: Is that Bob on your shirt? The cat from Burthorpe, good taste!
Bob's shirt! He gives such sensible advice, that cat.
insult: Does the cat know it's on your shirt, or did you not ask?
A cat shirt. Bob's got better things to do than be on your front.
remark: That cat on your shirt looks like he wants a word.
Bob says something or other on that shirt. He always does, does Bob.
kid/compliment: It's Bob! I love Bob! Can I stroke your shirt?
kid/insult: Bob's shirt's better on Bob.
