nan/compliment: Ooh, Bob! Lovely cat, that. Always says to mind your purse.
banker/remark: Bob says keep your valuables in the bank, and Bob is quite right.
trader/remark: Bob says mind your coins. Bad for business, that cat.

compliment: Father Christmas himself! Have you brought the presents?
The whole Santa suit, very jolly, but mind our chimneys!
insult: Father Christmas? You've lost weight, and the sleigh too.
Bit early for the Santa suit, isn't it? Unless you're very, very late.
remark: Evening, Santa. I was good this year, whatever my sister says.
Red suit, white trim, no sleigh. The reindeer have more sense.
kid/compliment: Santa! I've been good, ask my mum... no, don't ask my mum.
kid/insult: You're not the real Santa. The real one's much fatter than you.
nan/remark: Father Christmas, dear? You've not eaten enough, have a biscuit.
barkeep/remark: Santa! Sherry's on the house. Well, on the bar, and you pay for it.

compliment: A Santa hat in the wrong colours! Heard of those but never seen one.
That hat's worth more than my house and my neighbour's put together.
insult: A Santa hat gone wrong. Did it come out of the wash like that?
Christmas hat, wrong colour. Even Santa makes mistakes, I suppose.
remark: Mind that hat round here, it'd buy half the town.
Is that the wicked twin's hat? Santa had a wicked twin, they say.
kid/compliment: Your Santa hat's the wrong colour and I love it!
kid/insult: Santa's hat is red, so yours is wrong, so you're wrong.
trader/compliment: Name a figure for that hat, my friend, and I'll sell the shop.
shady/remark: I wonder, does a hat like that walk home alone?
banker/remark: A hat of that value ought to be in a vault, not on a head.

compliment: Did your nan knit that jumper? It looks cosy enough to nap in.
Festive jumper. Lovely. I can almost smell the mince pies.
insult: A Christmas jumper. Did you lose a bet, or win one?
Festive jumper. It's not even snowing. Commitment, I'll give you that.
kid/compliment: I like your jumper! It's all woolly like a sheep!
kid/insult: My nan made me one like that and I hid it under the bed.
nan/compliment: Ooh, a jumper like that takes weeks. Somebody loves you, dear.
barkeep/remark: Christmas jumper. Mulled wine's not on till the frost, mind.
heartland/remark: A Christmas jumper. Now I feel I ought to have got you something.

compliment: Bunny feet! Lucky, those. Not for the rabbit, mind.
You hop beautifully in that rabbit costume. Don't stop on my account.
insult: Dressed as a rabbit. Have you been at the carrots?
Big furry feet. Do you leave footprints the size of plates?
remark: Rabbit ears and big feet. The eggs will be along shortly, I expect.
Those feet look warm. I'll say that for them.
kid/compliment: A bunny! Hop for me and make it a big one!
kid/insult: You're a rubbish rabbit. Real ones are smaller and don't talk.
rough/remark: Big rabbit. Blimey. Keep it off my lettuces.
nan/remark: Ooh, bunny feet. Your mother dress you, did she, dear?

compliment: Egg helmet! Cracking, that is.
insult: An egg on your head. Did a very large hen have a go at you?
Egg head. Literally. I'd not stand near a frying pan.
remark: Mind you don't crack that egg on your head, or the other way about.
kid/compliment: Egg head! Is there chocolate inside if I crack it open?
kid/insult: Egg head! Everyone look at the egg head!
barkeep/remark: Egg on your head. Don't tempt the cook.
nan/remark: An egg, dear? On your head? Well, it's better than in your hair.
heartland/compliment: An egg for a head! Very festive, but don't let the hens see it.

compliment: Easter gear! Lovely. Where've you hidden the eggs?
Happy Easter, traveller. Chocolate for breakfast, I hope.
insult: Easter get-up. Did the bunny dress you, or was it a dare?
An Easter outfit. The chickens must be very confused.
kid/compliment: Have you got eggs? Give me the eggs and give me all of them!
kid/insult: Where's my egg? You've got no eggs at all, have you?
vicar/remark: Easter finery! Do come to the service. Bring an egg for the plate.
heartland/remark: Is it Easter? The eggs in the coop have gone very quiet.

compliment: Lovely, those pale robes. You're only half there in them.
insult: Are you eating properly? You look a bit transparent in those robes.
Ghost robes. Are you dead, or just dressed for it?
remark: Can I see through you, or is that the robes?
Those robes gave me a turn! You're not a ghost, are you?
kid/compliment: A ghost! Say woooo at me and do it properly!
kid/insult: You're not a real ghost. I poked you and my finger stopped.
vicar/remark: Those robes had me reaching for the holy water, and I may yet.
vicar/insult: Ghostly robes. If you're here for the exorcism, you're early.
nan/remark: You look half dead, dear. Oh! The robes do it, but eat something.
barkeep/remark: Thought you were the pub ghost for a second, and he owes me money.
heartland/compliment: Ghostly robes! You look very elsewhere, and it suits you.

compliment: A pumpkin for a head! That's cheered me right up, that has.
Pumpkin head! You've made my Halloween, that has.
insult: A pumpkin on your head. Is that a mask, or did one grow there?
Don't light a candle in that pumpkin head unless I'm there to watch.
remark: Pumpkin for a head. Hollowed it out yourself, did you?
Mind the candles with that head.
kid/compliment: Can I carve a face in your pumpkin... oh, there's one already.
kid/insult: Why have you got a vegetable where your head should be?
nan/remark: Pumpkin on your head, dear? That'd have made a lovely pie.
barkeep/remark: Pumpkin head. Soup's off, then.

compliment: Ooh, a skeleton! All your bones on the outside, very tidy.
Dressed as a skeleton. You've a lovely set of bones, I must say.
insult: In that skeleton suit I have to ask, when did you last eat?
Dressed as bones. I've seen more meat on a butcher's pencil.
remark: Bones on the outside. Saves the undertaker a job.
kid/compliment: A skeleton! Rattle for me!
kid/insult: You're not scary. The ones in the sewers are scarier.
vicar/insult: Dressed as the dead, by the graveyard. The tenants won't be amused.
nan/remark: Skin and bone, dear. Literally. Come in and have some stew.

compliment: Dressed as Death himself, and I've actually gone cold, look!
The reaper's robes. Marvellous. You've ruined my afternoon.
insult: Dressed as Death. Have you come for me, or just for the bread?
Isn't the Grim Reaper a bit keen, out in the daytime?
remark: Dressed as Death? Please say it's not my time yet.
kid/compliment: Hi, Death! Mum says I'm not allowed to talk to you, so bye!
kid/insult: You're not real Death. Real Death has a scythe.
vicar/remark: You're early, Death, and nobody's booked in with me today.
nan/remark: Not today, Death dear, there's a cake in the oven.
barkeep/remark: Death's in. Drinks on him, I should hope.
heartland/remark: If you're Death, I'd like a word about my knees.

compliment: Goggles and a scarf. You look like you've been up and liked it.
Ooh, a gnome scarf. Tally ho! Off up in a glider, are we?
insult: A gnome's scarf. Did you borrow it off a very small pilot?
Goggles on your head. Expecting weather, or just being dramatic?
remark: A scarf like that, you'll be joining the glider pilots next.
gnome/compliment: A gnome scarf, human! You've eaten well with us, I see.
gnome/remark: Dressed like a pilot, human. The gliders will think you're one.
kid/compliment: If you're a pilot with those goggles, take me up with you!
kid/insult: You've got a gnome's scarf. Did you steal it off a gnome?

compliment: A clown! Marvellous. Do the thing with the shoes.
Big shoes, stripy trousers. You've cheered the whole street up.
insult: Dressed as a clown. Was that the plan, or did it just happen?
Clown outfit. Very brave. Half the town's scared of clowns.
plain/insult: A clown. Finally, a job you look qualified for.
remark: Those shoes. How do you climb stairs?
Is there a circus in town, or is it just you?
kid/compliment: A clown! Do a trick! Do the thing with the water!
kid/insult: I don't like clowns! Go away! No, come back and do a trick!
nan/remark: A clown, dear? I've never trusted them, but have a biscuit anyway.
toff/insult: A clown? The court jester's position is filled, citizen, rather ably.

compliment: Dressed as a cow! Udderly brilliant.
A cow costume. Very convincing. The farmers'll be after you.
remark: Mind the farmer doesn't try to milk you.
kid/compliment: A cow! Say moo! Say it properly, like a real cow!
kid/insult: You're not a real cow. Real ones don't walk on two legs.
rough/remark: Cow, is it? Fine. Into the field with the others.
rough/insult: Dressed as a cow. I've a bull who'd like a word.
barkeep/remark: A cow. It's steak night. Best not look at the specials board.
heartland/insult: Dressed as a cow. Are you going to the field, or from it?
A cow. Right. Moo, I suppose.
heartland/remark: I was going to say something, but then a cow walked past, meaning you.

compliment: Dressed as a chicken! The foxes round here will love you.
Lovely plumage on that chicken suit! Does it moult in the spring?
insult: Dressed as a chicken? What's the matter, are you one?
Keep that chicken outfit away from the cook and his cleaver.
remark: A chicken. In town. Cluck once if you're all right.
kid/compliment: A chicken! Flap! Flap your wings!
kid/insult: Chickens can't even fly, so what's the point of being one?
barkeep/remark: A chicken. Kitchen's that way, if you're volunteering.
rough/remark: Chicken, eh? Mind the fox. He's had three this week.
heartland/remark: The chickens in Lumbridge are going to be very confused.

compliment: A powdered wig! Very distinguished. Have you come to sentence me?
That wig takes years off you or adds a title, and I can't tell which.
insult: A powdered wig. Are you a judge, or did a sheep land on you?
Lovely wig. Big do about nothing, if you ask me.
remark: Is that wig powdered, or has a baker sneezed on you?
A wig like that, you'll be sentencing people by teatime.
kid/compliment: Is your huge hair real? Can I pull it and find out?
kid/insult: You look like a fancy old lady in that wig, like the ones at church.
toff/compliment: A powdered wig. Now that is how one dresses to be obeyed.
toff/insult: A powdered wig on a commoner. The sheep must be furious.
banker/remark: A wig like that, I feel I should call you 'your honour'.

compliment: A highwayman's mask! Very dashing. Stand and deliver, I suppose.
You've a real flair for that highwayman mask.
insult: That mask says your money or your life, and I've neither, sorry.
Masked up. Robbing anyone today, or just dressed for it?
remark: The guards will have questions about that mask, mind.
That's bold, a highwayman's mask in broad daylight.
kid/compliment: A robber! Rob me! I've got a button!
kid/insult: You're not a real robber. A real one would've robbed me.
guard/insult: Either that highwayman mask comes off or you come with me.
guard/remark: A mask in town? I'm writing this one down very slowly.
trader/remark: A highwayman's mask, my friend? Stand well away from the till.
shady/compliment: A mask with purpose. Now you're dressing properly.

item.pattern: ^(Pirate('s)? (hat|hook|bandana|boots|leggings)|Stripy pirate|Big pirate hat|(Right|Left) eye patch|Hat eyepatch)
item.label: pirate gear

compliment: Arr, as they say! You've a proper sea dog look in that pirate get-up.
insult: Dressed as a pirate. Nearest sea's miles off, you know.
remark: Pirates in town. Lock up the rum.
Pirate hat but no ship? So it's just the hat, then.
pirate/compliment: Arr! Ye'll do, matey, a proper buccaneer and no mistake.
pirate/insult: Arr, pirate clothes on a landlubber who's never seen a wave.
kid/compliment: A pirate! Where's your treasure buried? I'll help you dig it all up!
kid/insult: You can't be a pirate with no hook... oh, that one probably counts.
barkeep/remark: A pirate, eh? Rum's that way, and you pay up front.
banker/remark: Pirate dress. I'll be keeping my hand on the drawer.
heartland/compliment: Pirate gear, very salty! Where's the parrot, then?
heartland/insult: A pirate, are you? Lost the ship in a card game, I expect.
parrot/insult: Squawk! Just the hat, just the hat!
mos_pirate/remark: Arr, one of us, be ye? Or just dressed as one?
mos_pirate/compliment: Now that be proper pirate rig, and no mistake.
mos_pirate/insult: Just the hat, is it? Where's yer ship, landlubber?

compliment: Ooh, a pith helmet! Are we off exploring somewhere intrepid?
Explorer's hat. You look like you'd know where north is.
insult: An explorer's hat, and you're lost in the market.
remark: Off to the jungle in that helmet, eh?
Explorer, are you? Explore the queue like the rest of us.
kid/compliment: Are you an explorer? Have you found a dinosaur?
kid/insult: If you're an explorer, what've you found apart from that hat?
toff/compliment: Splendid, one does like an explorer in a pith helmet, from a distance.
trader/remark: An explorer! I've maps, my friend, and they're mostly accurate.
heartland/insult: Pith helmet. Discovered anything, or just the bakery?

compliment: Bucket helm! Honest ironmongery. Nobody's getting through that.
insult: Did you know you've a bucket on your head, or is that news?
A bucket helmet. Did the well run dry, or did you?
plain/insult: Bucket on your head. Hope you emptied it first.
remark: Is that a bucket on your head? It is an actual bucket, isn't it?
Say something. I want to hear if it echoes in that helmet.
kid/insult: You've got a bucket on your head! Ha ha ha ha ha, a bucket!
kid/compliment: Nice bucket. Can I have a go?
dwarf/remark: A bucket helm? It's iron and it's on your head, so it counts.
rough/remark: Hang on. That's where me bucket went.
toff/insult: A bucket. On a head. The peasantry innovates.
banker/remark: We don't judge the bucket helm here. We simply make a note of it.
heartland/compliment: A bucket for a helmet is resourceful, and I respect that.

compliment: Humans Against Monsters, is it? Very brave of you in all that pink.
Convincing HAM robes, those. Mind the real ones don't adopt you.
insult: HAM robes, eh? Pink suits you, even if the cause doesn't.
Humans Against Monsters, eh? You look more Humans Against Laundry.
remark: They call that crimson. It's pink. Everyone knows it's pink.
Off to the HAM hideout, are you? Say hello to the sergeant.
kid/insult: You're pink! Pink pink pink!
kid/remark: Are you in the HAM? Mum says they're all daft.
vicar/remark: HAM robes. Zeal without sense. I'd stick to the pink, if I were you.
shady/insult: Your sort fits right in with HAM, pink fools shouting at goblins.
guard/remark: HAM robes? We know your lot, so behave yourself.
dwarf/insult: Humans Against Monsters. And dwarves count as what, exactly?
gnome/insult: HAM robes, human, and you know what they think of my people, hmph.

compliment: Desert robes. Sensible, those. The sun's got no purchase on you.
You look cool as a cucumber in those.
insult: Desert robes. It's drizzling. Is it drizzling where you're from?
remark: Those robes'll be no good when the wind gets up.
kid/remark: Why are you in your nightie?
kid/insult: Why do those robes look like you've had a bath in sand?
nan/remark: Desert robes, dear? You'll catch your death up here without a coat.
trader/compliment: Desert cloth! Fine weave. Al Kharid prices, I expect.
heartland/insult: Those robes are for Al Kharid, and all we've got here is cloud.
heartland/remark: Back from the desert, are you? Any sand in your boots still?
camel/remark: Desert robes. Sensible. You'll still burn, but slower.
camel/compliment: Dressed for the sand at last. Most of you arrive in iron.
camel/insult: Robes for the heat, and the desert will not be impressed, nor am I.

compliment: Mole slippers! Lovely. Comfiest feet in the kingdom, those.
Slippers shaped like moles! I've always been fond of a mole.
insult: Dear me, slippers outdoors and in public.
Slippers shaped like moles. Did you lose the real shoes down a hole?
remark: Mole slippers. Popped out for the milk and kept going, did you?
kid/compliment: Hello, moles! Your shoes have got little mole faces on them!
kid/insult: You're in your slippers outside! You'll be in so much trouble.
nan/compliment: Ooh, slippers. Sensible. Nobody wears slippers any more.
rough/remark: Mole slippers? Had one in me field for a month, not the slipper.
heartland/remark: Those slippers'll be ruined in the mud.

compliment: A gnome child's hat! Adorable. Does it come in grown-up?
Little hat, big head, and somehow it works on you.
insult: Is that a gnome child's hat? Did you take it off a gnome child?
Lovely hat. Was the gnome child done with it?
remark: Is your hat a bit small, or is your head a bit big?
gnome/remark: A gnome child's hat, human? Our children are wondering where it went.
gnome/compliment: Dressed like one of our little ones, human, how sweet is that?
kid/compliment: Swap you hats? Mine's only got the one hole in it.
kid/insult: That's a baby hat. You've got a baby hat on.
nan/compliment: Ooh, what a dear little hat. Did you make it yourself?

compliment: A sled! Well, it's a bold choice for a weapon, I'll give you that.
A sled, in this weather? That's hopeful, and I like hopeful.
remark: Mind the trolls, if you're off up the mountain with that sled.
kid/compliment: A sled! Give me a go on it once you've found some snow!
kid/insult: There's no snow, so you're just carrying a fancy plank about.
trader/remark: A sled, my friend? I've snow out the back, or a bucket of ice anyway.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A sled! Now you're thinking like a northerner, outerlander.
rough/remark: Blimey. Haven't seen a sled since the big snow.
heartland/insult: A sled. In this weather. Was there a mix-up at the stables?
A sled? Where's the snow, the hill, or the sense?
heartland/remark: There's no snow here. Was there snow where you started?

compliment: Ardougne work, that cloak, the way it drinks the shadows.
That cloak's done some good deeds round Ardougne, by the look.
insult: Shadowy cloak. Planning on sneaking anywhere, or just dressed for it?
A cloak like that says 'Ardougne'. So does the pickpocketing.
remark: An Ardougne cloak? The market there is all light fingers, mind.
kid/remark: Are you a spy? You look like a spy.
guard/remark: The Ardougne guards have stories about that cloak, so behave.
shady/compliment: A cloak for the shadows, how sensible of you.

compliment: That cape! You've done every good deed in every town, they say.
A cape covered in badges. You've been everywhere, haven't you.
insult: Helpful everywhere, says that cape. Exhausting for the rest of us.
That cape says every errand in the kingdom done, and still no chair?
remark: That cape says you've helped out in every town, even Yanille, eh?
kid/compliment: Have you been everywhere? Have you been to the moon?
kid/insult: A cape for doing chores? My mum would swap me for you.
toff/compliment: One ought to knight you for a cape like that, and yet one won't.
banker/remark: We admire a cape for diligence here, quietly, from behind the counter.

compliment: A cape with notes on it! Heard every tune in the land, have you?
A music cape! You must know them all, so hum us something.
insult: Was it hard work, listening to all that music for a cape?
Do you take requests in that music cape, or is it just for show?
remark: Is that cape humming, or is it you?
They say that cape's every song in Gielinor, even the Party Room one.
kid/compliment: If that cape's for music, sing something, sing the goblin one!
kid/insult: Music's boring. Have you got a sword instead?
barkeep/remark: Music cape, eh? We've a lute behind the bar, if you're brave enough.
toff/compliment: A patron of the arts! One is almost impressed, citizen.

compliment: Very proper, Saradomin's colours on your back.
Saradomin smile on you, with his star on that blue cape.
insult: Saradomin's colours. Does he know you're wearing them?
remark: They say that cape's from the mage arena. Brave place to shop, that.
vicar/compliment: Saradomin's cape! A fellow of the faith, then, so do come in.
vicar/insult: Saradomin's colours, and still I never see you at prayers.
shady/insult: Saradomin does like his people to be seen, and more's the pity.
kid/remark: Is that the good god or the bad god?
wizard/remark: That cape came from Kolodion's arena I expect, and he owes me a drink.
heartland/insult: Saradomin's cape. Been to church lately, or just the Wilderness?

compliment: Zamorak's colours! Bold. Chaos has its charms, I'm told.
Red cape, Zamorak's mark. You've picked a side, and it's a lively one.
insult: Zamorak's cape. Chaos, is it? Your outfit certainly agrees.
remark: Zamorak's colours. Keep that quiet in Falador.
vicar/insult: Zamorak's cape outside my church, so I'll pray for you, and loudly.
vicar/remark: Door's open to all, Zamorak's colours too, but wipe your feet twice.
shady/compliment: Zamorak's colours. Finally, someone with sense.
kid/insult: That's the bad god's cape! The vicar's going to go spare.
guard/remark: Zamorak's cape? The watch has no view on that, officially.
heartland/insult: Zamorak's cape. Hope you've a good excuse for the vicar.

compliment: Guthix's green and balance in all things? How very sensible of you.
A Guthix cape. The druids would approve.
insult: Guthix's cape, so you'll be balanced? You're leaning a bit left.
Green cape for the god of balance. Still can't walk straight, I see.
remark: Guthix's colours. Sitting on the fence, nicely dressed.
vicar/remark: Guthix's cape is neither here nor there, rather like my sermons.
kid/remark: Green cape! Are you a druid? Can you do the rain thing?
shady/insult: Guthix? The god of not deciding? Suits you down to the ground.

compliment: Clever contraption on your back, that. Is there a chicken in it?
A clever lady at Draynor Manor builds those devices, they say.
insult: Did you know there's a chicken on your back, because it knows?
A bag with a chicken in it. Is that armour, or lunch?
remark: Your cape's clucking.
Mind that magnet near the cutlery.
kid/compliment: Can I feed the chicken on your back if it likes crusts?
kid/insult: Your chicken looks sad. You're a bad chicken owner.
rough/remark: Is that one o' my hens on your back? One went missing last week.
wizard/remark: A magnetic chicken. Not magic, strictly. Still, one admires the nerve.
trader/remark: A device on your back? Then you'll be wanting fewer of my arrows.

insult: A wooden shield. Lovely for kindling, if it comes to that.
plain/insult: A practice sword. The goblins are ever so worried.
kid/insult: Your shield's made of wood, same as my door!
heartland/compliment: Fresh from the combat tutor? Well, everyone starts somewhere.

compliment: Leather. Sensible. It won't rust in the rain, at least.
insult: Leather armour. It'll keep the drizzle off, if not the goblins.
rough/remark: Lumbridge cowhide, that. I'd know those cows anywhere.
kid/remark: You smell like a cow, but one of the nice ones.
guard/compliment: Leather's nothing a watchman need worry about, so carry on.
guard/remark: Leather armour. Same as ours, only yours fits.
guard/insult: Leather. Not armour, strictly. A thick coat with ambitions.

compliment: Studs on the leather. Coming up in the world, aren't you?
insult: All those studs. Do they do anything, or are they for show?
dwarf/remark: Studs knocked into hide. Rough work, but somebody tried.
kid/compliment: Can I press one of the buttons on your armour, just the one?
guard/remark: Studs are for show on that leather, and the watch has tried them.
guard/insult: Studs on the leather. Don't lean on the paintwork.
guard/compliment: Studded leather. Sensible. Nobody starts a riot in studded leather.

compliment: Up from bronze to iron, then? That's proper progress, that is.
insult: Iron armour. Give it a wipe, it's going orange at the edges.
dwarf/insult: Iron. We use that for horseshoes, human.
kid/insult: Your armour's gone rusty! Did you leave it out in the rain?
gnome/compliment: Iron, human. Sturdy. Just don't fall in the river.
gnome/insult: Iron armour, and you still want a lift on a glider, kar?
dwarf/compliment: I'll not sneer at iron, plain and honest and worked by hand.
dwarf/remark: Iron rusts, human. Keep it oiled or it'll go orange on you.
goblin/insult: Grey armour. Grey not a goblin colour. Grey not even a colour.
goblin/remark: Iron. Generals want big lump of iron for soldiers. For hitting.
goblin/compliment: Iron armour. Strong goblin swing big lump of iron. Human just wear it.
troll/insult: Iron on human. Still tinned human. Just harder tin.
troll/remark: Iron armour. Trolls not bother. Trolls got rock skin for free.
troll/compliment: Iron. Heavy. Human carry heavy good. Nearly troll.
guard/remark: Iron. Same as the cell doors. You'll feel at home if it comes to it.
guard/insult: Keep that rusting iron off the benches.
guard/compliment: Iron. Honest metal. Nothing to worry a watchman.
barbarian/remark: Iron. Good honest metal. Half the longhall wears it.
barbarian/insult: Iron plate, dented already, or did it come like that?
barbarian/compliment: Iron on your back is plain and heavy, and that's how we like it.

compliment: Steel armour. Nice and bright. Someone's been saving up.
insult: Steel armour like everyone else? You'll blend right in nicely.
rough/compliment: Good steel, that. Somebody had a long day at the furnace.
kid/compliment: You're all shiny! I can see my face in you!
gnome/compliment: Steel! Bright as a glider wing, human, and very smart.
gnome/remark: Steel armour. Humans do love clanking about.
dwarf/compliment: Steel! Now who hammered that out for you?
dwarf/insult: Steel's fine. My apprentice makes steel on a slow day.
dwarf/remark: Steel takes twice the coal but gives twice the strength, human.
goblin/insult: Shiny grey armour. Shiny grey still grey. Human pick proper colour.
goblin/remark: Steel armour. All humans wear that. Humans all look same anyway.
goblin/compliment: Steel look strong. Not brown, but strong. Me allow it.
troll/insult: Steel. Shiny tin. Hurt troll teeth, so trolls just squish it flat.
troll/remark: Steel human. Clang clang when walk. Trolls hear you coming from far.
troll/compliment: Shiny steel. Human look like strong tin. Strong tin good.
guard/remark: Half the town's in steel, so I can't tell you apart, which is useful.
guard/insult: Fancy yourself a guard in that steel? We do have standards, low ones.
guard/compliment: Steel. Decent kit. Keep it clean and I've no complaints.
barbarian/remark: Every city soldier wears steel like that, so you could pass for one.
barbarian/insult: Shiny steel, not a scratch on it, so you've never used it.
barbarian/compliment: Steel, and scratched. Now that's armour that's been somewhere.

compliment: Very striking, that black armour, and very serious.
insult: All in black. You're not one of the Black Knights, I hope?
remark: The White Knights won't like that colour on you.
kid/remark: Are you a Black Knight? My mum says they're wicked.
goblin/remark: Black armour. Huzamogaarb tribe wear black. Human from that tribe?
goblin/insult: Black armour make human look like shadow. Ugly shadow.
goblin/compliment: Black armour. Dark colour. Goblins like dark earthy colour. Close.
guard/remark: Black armour stands out at night, which makes my job easier.
Black armour's not against the rules, and I did check.
guard/insult: Black armour. I'll need to see what's under the helmet.

compliment: Very dashing, that curved sword. Did you buy it in Al Kharid?
plain/insult: Did that sword come curved, or did you sit on it?
guard/remark: Keep that blade put away in town, because I'm watching.
kid/compliment: Is your sword bendy because it's a pirate one?

compliment: Now that's a proper staff, with the little orb on top, isn't it?
insult: Lovely staff. Do you walk with it as well, or is it for show?
wizard/insult: One element on a stick. How terribly apprentice of you.
kid/remark: Do some magic with that staff! Do a fire, a really big one!
guard/remark: Staff with a stone on it. Keep the stone pointed at the sky.
guard/insult: No spells inside the walls. The sign's by the gate, the scorched one.
guard/compliment: A staff. At least you can't swing it very fast.

compliment: A bow. Sensible. Keeps the trouble at a distance.
insult: That bow's barely been told it isn't a branch any more.
rough/remark: Did you make that bow yourself? It's got a bit of a lean to it.
kid/compliment: Can I have a go on your bow? I'll aim at the chickens.
guard/remark: Bow stays unstrung in town. The rabbits are outside the wall.
guard/insult: A bow. In a street. Who exactly are you planning to shoot?
guard/compliment: Little bow, harmless enough, so keep it that way.

compliment: Plain robes. You've a peaceful look about you.
remark: Monk's robes. Off to Edgeville to pray, are you?
plain/insult: Did you just take those monk's robes, with no monastery in sight?
kid/insult: Are you a monk? Is that why you're in a dress and boring?

compliment: Lovely blue sheen on that mithril. You're coming along nicely.
dwarf/compliment: Mithril. Now that's a metal worth the mining, human.
kid/compliment: Your armour's blue like magic! Is it magic or just blue?
gnome/compliment: Mithril! Lighter than it looks, human. You almost move like a gnome.
gnome/insult: Blue armour? Very fetching, human, though it matches nothing.
dwarf/insult: Mithril, human. Good, but a dwarf doesn't stop there.
dwarf/remark: Deep ore, mithril, and someone sweated for that.
goblin/insult: Blue armour. Blue make Grubfoot sad. Make me sad too, looking.
goblin/remark: Blue armour. Generals try blue once. Not goblin colour at all.
goblin/compliment: Blue armour. Ekeleshuun tribe wear blue. Human nearly goblin tribe.
troll/compliment: Blue metal! Pretty, like ice rocks up in cold mountains.
troll/insult: Blue armour. Blue like cold human. Cold human taste same.
troll/remark: Blue metal. Troll not know dat one. Troll bite it, find out.
guard/remark: Mithril's light, they say, but is it light enough to outrun me?
guard/compliment: Tidy, that mithril. Nobody causes trouble in mithril, or hasn't yet.
guard/insult: Mithril armour? Blue's a suspicious colour, blue.

compliment: Adamant! That's proper armour. You're coming along, aren't you?
kid/insult: You look like a big green beetle!
gnome/compliment: Green armour, human! Very leafy. The Grand Tree would approve.
gnome/insult: Adamant. Great Guthix, human, how do you lift your arms?
dwarf/compliment: Adamant. Hard to smith, hard to dent. Someone knew their trade.
dwarf/insult: Adamant armour. Nearly rune. Nearly is a long way, human.
dwarf/remark: Adamant. Green as a gemstone. The Green Gemstone would approve.
goblin/compliment: Green armour! Wartface say green best! Me agree. When he listening.
goblin/insult: Green armour, human? Green too much like skin. Human nearly naked.
goblin/remark: Green armour. Red goblins hit you for that. Brown goblins just stare.
troll/compliment: Green armour. Green like goutweed! Me approve.
troll/insult: Green human. Like goat food. Goat eat you, then troll eat goat.
troll/remark: Green metal. Not a plant. Me check. Not a plant.
guard/compliment: Adamant. Proper kit. The watch gets leather and a whistle.
guard/remark: Green metal on the gate, and I'm noting it down as green.
guard/insult: Adamant head to toe. Expecting a war in the market, are we?

compliment: Is that dragonhide? You've been and fought a dragon, then!
insult: Green dragonhide. Still smells faintly of dragon, that.
kid/remark: Did you skin a dragon for that armour yourself, was it scary?
goblin/compliment: Green leather! Wartface say green best! Garagorshuun tribe colour!
goblin/insult: Green leather. Green too much like skin, Bentnoze say. Nearly naked.
goblin/remark: Green dragon skin. Human kill dragon? Goblins just shout at dragon.
guard/remark: Green hide. Archer, then. Bow stays on your back in town.
guard/insult: Green dragonhide. Suspiciously quiet boots to go with it, I'll bet.
guard/compliment: Green hide and sensible boots, so you'll do.

remark: Snakeskin? I do hope the snake had finished with it.
kid/compliment: You're wearing a snake! That's the best thing ever!

remark: Is that bark? You're wearing a tree, more or less.
kid/insult: Can I climb you, since you're dressed as a tree?

remark: Does that armour smell? It looks like it came out of the sea.
fremennik/compliment: Dagannoth hide! You've been down in the deep caves, then.
kid/remark: You look like a crab! A big crab with legs.

item.pattern: ^(Helm of neitiznot|Berserker helm|Archer helm|Farseer helm|Warrior helm)
item.label: helm

compliment: A northern helm! You've been to Rellekka and back, I see.
Northern helm, that. You look like you crossed a sea for it.
fremennik/remark: That helm is Skulgrimen's work, so wear it with honour.
An island helm on a southerner. The trolls must be slipping.
kid/compliment: Can I wear your pointy helmet? I promise I won't poke anyone.
Is your helmet a fish? It looks ever so much like a fish.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A proper helm. Skulgrimen does not hand those to just anyone.
fremennik/insult: A Fremennik helm. The helm is Fremennik. The head, I am less sure.
moon_clan/compliment: Gentler thoughts than that northern helm suggests, which is good.
moon_clan/insult: A Fremennik helm. Oh my. We fell out with those long ago, dear.
tortugan/compliment: A fine helm, a shell for the head, very sensible.
tortugan/remark: A northern helm. The far cold sea. We do not swim there often.
troll/compliment: Horn helmet! Human look like goat. Trolls like goat.
troll/insult: Horns on head. Human look like goat. Goat taste boring.
troll/remark: Helmet with horns. Trolls bash dat off first. Then dinner.
moon_clan_wary/insult: A Fremennik helm. Pah. Horns do nothing for the mind beneath.
If that helm is meant to keep your thoughts in, it is not working.
Horns on your head. The Fremennik way: look fierce, think little.
moon_clan_wary/remark: A northern helm, so they sent one of their own again, and we watch.
moon_clan_wary/compliment: A Fremennik helm on someone who actually listens, for once.
barbarian/compliment: A horned helm! Now that's a proper helmet, Peksa would approve.
barbarian/remark: Horns on your helmet. Our cousins up north wear those.
barbarian/insult: Horned helm, no scars. The helmet's done more fighting than you.

vicar/compliment: Armour with Saradomin's blessing on it, and it suits you, traveller.
sharp/insult: Does Falador know you're wandering about in a knight's armour?
kid/compliment: If you're a real knight, where's your horse?

guard/remark: That's a proper blade. Keep it sheathed and we'll get on.
kid/insult: Bet I could take that sword off you because I'm ever so quick.

compliment: A rune scimitar! Now you look like you mean business.
guard/remark: Rune blade on your hip. Move along, and keep it there.
kid/compliment: Cor, a rune sword! Can I hold it, just for a little bit?

compliment: A battlestaff! The magic's coming along nicely, I see.
wizard/remark: A battlestaff. Zaff's, I'd wager. He does sell a lot of them.
kid/remark: Make your stick do sparks! I know it does sparks really.
guard/remark: Battlestaff, is it? It's the battle part I'm not keen on.
Staff like that, I'll want both hands on it and both in view.
guard/insult: Keep that staff still. Last one that waved, we lost a roof.

compliment: A proper bow, that. You've come a long way from sticks.
rough/remark: Good straight wood in that bow. Someone knew their trees.
kid/compliment: Can you hit a bird with that big bow? Not a nice bird, mind, a crow.
guard/remark: Proper longbow. Unstrung inside the walls, if you please.
guard/insult: A bow that size could hit the next town, so don't.
guard/compliment: Fine bow. I'll want it on your back, not in your hand.

remark: A cape with a number on it. Off to the Wilderness, are we?
kid/remark: If that number means you're in a gang, can I join it?

compliment: A stone cape? Down the volcano for that, were you?
A cape of stone. You must have shoulders like an ox.
dwarf/compliment: Volcanic glass for a cape. Odd, but you can't fault the work.
kid/remark: Doesn't your back hurt, with a cape made of rock?
remark: If that cape's made of rock, how does it swish?
kid/insult: Your cape's made of rock. You'll sink in the river.

compliment: Is that a Legends' Guild cape? You look ever so distinguished in it.
toff/insult: The Legends' Guild, citizen? They let anyone in nowadays.
kid/compliment: If you're a real legend, prove it and do something legendary!

compliment: Proper dragonhide. Somebody had a very bad day for that.
insult: Dragon leather, is it? It still looks a bit cross.
kid/remark: Did the dragon mind when you took its skin for that armour?
gnome/compliment: Dragon leather! Light enough to glide in, human, or nearly.
gnome/remark: Dragonhide, human? The gliders stay well clear of dragons, wisely.
dwarf/compliment: Dragon leather's tough stuff, well stitched, not metal but not bad.
dwarf/insult: Leather, human? Next to a good steel plate, that's a nice coat.
dwarf/remark: Dragonhide. The dragon wasn't using it, I suppose.
goblin/remark: Dragon skin. Blue, red, black. Human pick tribe colour by mistake.
goblin/insult: Dragon leather. Still just leather. Goblin mail proper metal. Brown.
goblin/compliment: Dragon skin! Human fight dragon! Big High War God like that fight.
troll/remark: Dragon skin on human. Troll not eat dragon. Too big. Dragon eat troll.
troll/insult: Dragon leather. Chewy. Troll spit dat bit out.
troll/compliment: Human wear dragon skin! Human eat dragon? Big human. Big dinner.
guard/remark: Dragonhide. Archer's kit. I'll want the quiver covered in town.
guard/insult: Dragon leather? Dragons don't come through this gate, nor do arrows.
guard/compliment: The sergeant would weep at that hide: quiet, light and no clanking.

compliment: Lovely robes. You look like you know a spell or two.
wizard/insult: Robes and a pointy hat. Everyone's a wizard these days.
kid/remark: Turn me into a frog, go on, just for a little bit!
guard/remark: Mystic robes? No fireballs in town, as we've had letters about it.
guard/insult: A wizard? Hands where I can see them, both of them.
guard/compliment: Fancy robes. At least you'll not be hiding a sword in those.
barbarian/insult: Bah! Fancy robes and all that magic, and not one scar on you.
barbarian/remark: We don't trust magic robes here, the sword doesn't lie.
barbarian/compliment: Fine robes, and still you walked in here, there's nerve in that.

remark: Keep that crossbow pointed at the ground, if you would.
guard/remark: That crossbow stays unloaded inside the walls while I'm watching it.
kid/compliment: Can I have a go? I'll only aim at the pigeons.

compliment: Bow cut from a magic tree. You can see it shimmer, look.
insult: A bow that pretty. I do hope you hit things with it.
kid/insult: Is your bow sparkly because it's for fairies?
guard/remark: Why's that bow glowing? Bows shouldn't glow, so I'm noting the glow.
guard/insult: Enchanted bow, in a crowd. I'd call that a public hazard.
guard/compliment: Pretty bow. I'll not pretend I'm not watching it.

remark: Small, red and wicked, that dagger. A very sensible size for the job.
guard/remark: A dragon dagger in town? I'll be keeping an eye on that.
kid/compliment: Your knife's red! Is it made of dragon?

compliment: Dragon metal! You've done well for yourself.
remark: Red as a forge, that. Do they make it that colour on purpose?
guard/remark: That's dragon metal. Keep it lowered and we'll get on fine.
kid/compliment: Is that from a dragon? Did you fight it yourself?
barbarian/compliment: Red metal blade! Hah! Our forefathers would've fought you for it.
barbarian/insult: Dragon weapon, and not a notch in it, so you bought it, then.
barbarian/remark: A red blade, the mighty sword or the vicious axe, good choice.

compliment: Little spiked shield. Someone's been busy at the Warriors' Guild.
insult: A shield that small. Expecting very small arrows?
kid/remark: Why's your shield so tiny? Did it shrink in the wash?

compliment: Are those stars on your robes? Look, the stars are moving!
insult: Robes full of stars. A touch showy, if I may say.
kid/remark: Your clothes have got the night sky on them!

remark: Old staff, that. Smells faintly of desert.
wizard/insult: Ancient magicks. Popular with people who ought to know better.
kid/compliment: Is your stick cursed? Is that why it's all twisty and black?

compliment: You must have studied for a wand as distinguished as that.
wizard/insult: A little wand. In my day we used staves, like grown-ups.
kid/remark: Make a cake appear with your wand, a big one with icing!

remark: Odd sort of book to carry about openly, with a cover that dark.
vicar/insult: That's not a book I'd carry past a temple, friend.
kid/remark: Your book looks evil! Read us the worst bit out of it!

remark: Is the dragon on that shield there to warn the real ones off?
plain/insult: Not a dragon for miles, and still you lug that dragon shield about.
kid/compliment: If that shield stops fire, can I set it on fire to check?

remark: Is your whip moving on its own? Because it's moving on its own.
insult: Something's wrapped round your whip, and it's wriggling at me.
kid/remark: Your whip's got a squid on it!

remark: That club looks like it was grown, not made.
plain/insult: Lovely club. Did it come out of something's insides?
kid/insult: Your club looks like a big gut and I can't stop looking!

vicar/insult: Have you no shame, carrying Zamorak's colours past the chapel?
shady/compliment: Now you're talking, red and black and sharp at the end.
kid/compliment: Can I hold the spiky spear, just the not-spiky end?

compliment: Fine work, that crossbow, in Armadyl's colours and all.
guard/remark: Fancy crossbow. Fancy or not, it stays unloaded in town.
kid/compliment: Does your crossbow fly, with those wings on it?

remark: A staff with a blade on it. Can't you make your mind up?
wizard/insult: A staff you hit people with. Our forefathers would weep.
kid/remark: Is that a stick or a sword or a stick-sword?

compliment: That blade's elf work, and you can see clean through it.
plain/insult: Glass sword. Very pretty. Very breakable, I'd think.
kid/compliment: Can I look through your sword, since it's made of glass?

remark: That's a hammer for walls, not nails.
guard/remark: Big red hammer. Leave the gates in one piece, please.
kid/insult: That hammer's even bigger than your head, and your head's big.

remark: Claws on a person. Do you scratch at doors as well?
guard/remark: Hands where I can see them, and the claws as well.
kid/compliment: You've got claws! Are you part dragon?

remark: Was the snake consulted about being your hat?
insult: That hat's got scales. I keep thinking it'll hiss at me.
kid/remark: Does the snake on your head bite? Has it ever bitten you on the ear?

compliment: Fine work, that shield, even if the face on it looks cross with me.
dwarf/compliment: Dragon bone forged to a shield. That's a smith's dream, that.
kid/compliment: Make your dragon shield breathe fire at that bush, go on!

remark: You've brought a siege engine into town under one arm.
guard/remark: That's a siege weapon, and it's not coming into town on my watch.
kid/compliment: Your crossbow's enormous! Shoot the moon down with it!

compliment: A face like a war mask. Very fierce, very northern.
fremennik/compliment: Hah! A faceguard from the isles. You've earned a drink for that.
kid/remark: Are you in there? I can't see your face at all.

remark: Dark robes and a deep hood. You'd frighten a cultist.
vicar/insult: Chaos robes, here? I'll say a prayer for you, and a long one.
shady/compliment: Robes of the old faith. You've good taste, for once.
kid/remark: Are you a bad wizard? You look like a bad wizard.

compliment: Splendid thing, that blade, like a great curved tooth from the desert.
plain/insult: Did you knock first, when you took that blade from the pharaoh's tomb?
kid/compliment: Is that a giant tooth? Did you pull it out yourself?
guard/remark: That's a tooth on a handle. Keep it pointed at the ground.

compliment: That sword looks like a hole in the day, and oddly it suits you.
remark: Your sword's crackling. I can feel it in my teeth.
kid/compliment: Your sword's fizzing purple! Make it fizz again for me!
guard/remark: Crackling sword. Sheathe it, or crackle somewhere else.

compliment: Very handsome crossbow, that, ancient work by the look of it.
kid/compliment: Your crossbow's purple! Purple ones are the best ones!
guard/insult: Point that crossbow at the sky in the square, and higher than that.

compliment: Well carried, that axe, it looks like it's taken a soul or two.
remark: Is that axe whispering, or is it me? I'd much rather it were me.
vicar/remark: An axe that feeds on souls, so they say, and I'll pray for yours.
kid/insult: Your axe looks hungry. Keep it away from my dog.

compliment: Handsome bow, that, from some old empire or other.
insult: A fine bow. One hopes you're the one doing the hunting.
kid/remark: What do you hunt with that bow? It's dragons, isn't it, dragons?

item.pattern: ^(Accursed sceptre|Ursine chainmace|Webweaver bow|Thammaron's sceptre|Craw's bow|Viggora's chainmace)
item.label: weapon

compliment: I'd wager that weapon came off the Wilderness dead, yet here you are.
plain/insult: Don't wave Wilderness spoils about, as someone always wants them back.
shady/compliment: A weapon taken in the Wilderness. You've more nerve than I thought.
kid/remark: Did you get that in the Wilderness? Mum says I can't go there.

compliment: That weapon's still smouldering. Demon work, by the smell of it.
kid/compliment: It's on fire! Can I toast bread on it?
tzhaar/compliment: Weapon still burning. Good. JalYt learns.
guard/remark: Burning weapon inside the walls. That's a fire risk, that.
heartland/remark: Mind the thatch with that burning blade, and the hay, and me.

compliment: A Colosseum quiver! They don't hand those out lightly.
insult: Is a quiver where a cape should go the fashion now?
kid/compliment: Did everyone cheer when you won that quiver in the big arena?
guard/remark: That quiver says you fight for crowds, so please don't do it here.

compliment: You fair glow in that sun and gold armour, don't you?
vicar/remark: Armour for a sun god, not ours, but nicely made all the same.
kid/insult: You look like a big orange that's put a helmet on!

remark: Is that staff looking at me? It is. It's looking right at me.
nan/remark: A staff that watches you back, dear? I'd keep that in a drawer.
kid/compliment: Your stick's got an eye! Make it blink at me and not at him!

compliment: Is that the moon on your armour? Old work, that, and lovely with it.
remark: Moon on your armour. Do you wane a bit, of an evening?
kid/remark: Why've you got the moon on your hat when it's daytime?

plain/insult: Is that a sword or a butter knife? I honestly can't tell from here.
guard/remark: Keep that blade sheathed in town, adventurer, because I'm watching.
kid/remark: Can I hold your sword? I promise I won't swing it, not much.

compliment: A good heavy weapon. Goblins don't argue with those.
guard/remark: Keep that low, and your temper lower.
kid/compliment: Bonk a goblin with that big hammer, go on, bonk one!

compliment: A great big sword. You must have arms like a blacksmith.
guard/remark: Mind where you swing that sword, because there are windows here.
kid/remark: Your sword's bigger than me! Is it as heavy as it looks?

remark: A spear in town. Hoping to catch a fish in the fountain?
guard/remark: Point that at the sky, please, not at the citizens.
kid/remark: If you're going hunting with that spear, get me a rabbit!

insult: A stick. You've a stick. The Wizards' Tower must be trembling.
wizard/insult: A staff with nothing on top. You've bought the handle, then.
kid/insult: That's just a stick! I've got loads of sticks at home.

guard/remark: Crossbows get watched in this town, so keep it unloaded.
shady/remark: Where did you come by that crossbow? It looks awfully familiar.
kid/compliment: Shoot an apple off my head with that crossbow, please, please!

compliment: Good to see a working tool in someone's hand for once.
dwarf/compliment: Honest tool for honest work, and dwarves approve of that, human.
kid/remark: Are you a lumberjack or a miner, or a bit of both?

compliment: A candy cane! You've a festive look about you.
insult: Fighting with a sweet. The goblins will laugh themselves silly.
kid/remark: Can I lick your candy cane just once if I don't tell anyone?

remark: You know that snowball's going to melt, don't you?
guard/remark: Put the snowball down slowly and nobody needs to get wet.
kid/remark: Don't throw it at me! Throw it at my sister!

compliment: A little tiara. Very regal, in a small way.
toff/insult: A tiara on the peasantry, so whatever next, a throne?
kid/remark: Are you a princess? You've got a crown!

compliment: A boater! How smart and summery you look in that.
toff/compliment: A boater. At last, someone with a sense of occasion.
kid/remark: Your hat's flat on top! Can I put my cup on it?

remark: Do you paint, or is the beret just for show?
insult: A beret. Off to sell paintings nobody asked for?
kid/remark: Can I eat your hat if it's as floppy as a pancake?

rough/compliment: Mining helmet. Someone's done their time underground.
dwarf/compliment: A lamp on the helm! Proper miner's gear, human.
kid/remark: Can you see in the dark with that lamp on your head?

remark: You've a fishbowl on your head, so where's the fish gone?
insult: A goldfish bowl. Did the fish move out, or did you evict it?
kid/remark: You look like a fish! A fish wearing a fish house!

compliment: Ooh, an animal face! Are you off to a masked ball?
insult: Lovely mask. An improvement, if I'm honest.
kid/remark: Do the noise! Go on! What noise does it make?

compliment: A woolly hat. Warm ears are happy ears.
nan/compliment: Lovely woolly hat, dear. Did someone knit you that?
kid/remark: Can I have your hat after you? It looks ever so warm and woolly.

compliment: A priest's gown. Good to see the cloth out and about.
vicar/compliment: Greetings, traveller! The gown suits you, and Saradomin smile on you.
kid/remark: Are you a priest? Do you know any ghost stories?

compliment: Druid's robes. You've a good earthy look about you.
wizard/insult: Druids. Herbs and stone circles. Charming, in a mossy way.
kid/remark: You smell like leaves, but the good sort, not the wet sort.

vicar/insult: Zamorak's colours. I'll pray for you, whether you like it or not.
guard/remark: Zamorakian robes. I'll be keeping an eye on you.
kid/remark: Mum says I'm not to talk to people in red robes, so bye!

remark: An apron. Baking, smithing, or ready for anything?
barkeep/compliment: An apron! Grab a cloth, we're short-handed tonight.
kid/remark: If you're making cakes, can I lick the bowl?

compliment: Gold for the kitchen! Very grand for a cook.
barkeep/remark: Gold apron, is it? Don't spill gravy down that.
kid/compliment: You're all gold! Are you the king of the kitchen?

remark: Got any sandwiches? You look like you've got sandwiches.
insult: Dressed as the sandwich lady. She'll want her tray back.
barkeep/remark: Selling sandwiches? Not in here you're not.
kid/compliment: The sandwich lady! Can I have a free one, please, please?

compliment: Kourend robes, by the look. You've a scholarly air about you.
wizard/insult: That robe hums with old magic. More than its wearer does.
kid/remark: Your robes look old! Did you find them in a tomb?

insult: Khazard's armour. Did you rob a guard, or just sit on one?
guard/remark: Khazard's livery. You're a long way from his arena.
kid/remark: Are you nasty, like the guards at the arena you're dressed as?

remark: A hard hat. Expecting something to fall on you?
toff/insult: A tradesman. The servants' entrance is round the side.
kid/remark: If you're building a tower, can I have the top room?

compliment: A nice plain skirt. Comfy for walking, I should think.
insult: A skirt and nothing much to go with it is brave in this wind.
kid/remark: Your skirt's all swishy! Do a twirl and make it swish!

compliment: Gnome fashion! You've been up the Grand Tree, haven't you?
gnome/compliment: Rometti's work, human! You wear it almost properly.
kid/remark: You're dressed like a gnome! You're too big to be a gnome!

compliment: A nice bright cape. Every adventurer needs one.
insult: A plain dyed cape. Everybody's got one of those.
kid/compliment: Swish your cape, go on, swish it like a hero does!

remark: Spotted fur. Where did you find a cat that big?
rough/compliment: Kebbit fur, that. Someone's been out with a falcon.
kid/remark: Does your cape bite, with spots like that?
Are those spots on your cape catching?
compliment: Lovely spotted fur. You've been hunting, I see.
rough/remark: Kebbit fur, that. Fast little things to catch.
insult: Spotty cape. Matches nothing, if I may say.

remark: Is your cape made of cabbage? It is, isn't it. It's cabbage...
insult: A cabbage cape. Did the field lose a fight with you?
kid/insult: You're wearing cabbages and Mum makes me eat those!

remark: Bells on your cape. We'll hear you coming, at least.
toff/compliment: A jester, how amusing. Do juggle something for one.
kid/remark: Your cape jingles! Jingle it again and again!

remark: Did you know there's a parrot on your shoulder?
pirate/compliment: Arr, a parrot! Now ye look like a proper sea dog.
plain/insult: That bird's left something on your shoulder, by the way.
kid/compliment: A parrot! Does it talk? Make it say something rude!

remark: Is that a wolf on your head? It's a wolf on your head.
I'll bet it's warm, wearing a whole wolf like that.
fremennik/compliment: Dressed as a wolf, outerlander? Good, wolves are respected here.
A wolf's hide. You have hunted, outerlander.
kid/remark: Awoo! If you're a werewolf you have to howl back at me!
plain/insult: Wolf skin. The wolf looked better in it.
kid/compliment: You're a wolf, so howl at something and do it properly!

compliment: A defender. You've been at the Warriors' Guild, then.
guard/remark: A blade in each hand. That's one more than I like to see.
kid/remark: You've got a sword in your other hand as well, two swords!

remark: Did you make that shield yourself? I'd not know which end to hold.
insult: Mind the dragons. That shield's kindling to them.
kid/remark: Is that a tray? It looks like a tray!

compliment: A great blue sword. You've been saving up for that one.
guard/remark: That sword's longer than my arm. Walk it carefully, please.
kid/compliment: Can I hold your sword, just the end? I'm much bigger than I look!

dwarf/compliment: You'll go far with rune and a good honest head on it.
guard/remark: Heavy blue metal on a stick. Mind how you swing it in here.
kid/remark: Squash that bucket with that great big weapon, go on!

compliment: A rune blade. Someone's been working hard, I see.
guard/remark: That's a fine blade. Kindly keep it pointing at the ground.
kid/compliment: Your sword's blue! Is it made out of sky?

remark: Adamant, by the green of it. Coming along nicely, aren't you?
dwarf/remark: Adamant. Decent stuff. Rune's better, but you'll get there.
kid/insult: Has your weapon gone mouldy, or is it meant to be green?

remark: A dark staff with a nasty point. Off hunting monsters, are we?
wizard/remark: A slayer's staff, good for the one spell, which is very specialised.
kid/compliment: Do you kill real monsters with that staff, big ones, with teeth?
slayer_master/remark: A slayer's staff. Sensible, for some of the things out there.

remark: That bow's nearly as tall as you. Did you borrow it off an ogre?
ogre/compliment: Ha! Good big bow. Make chompy go splat.
kid/compliment: That's the biggest bow I ever saw! Can it shoot the moon down?

compliment: A proper wand! Been studying at the arena, have you?
wizard/insult: A student's wand means we all start somewhere, though some stay there.
kid/remark: Wave it! Turn the cat into a bigger cat!

compliment: That hat says you've been fighting at the barbarian outpost, eh?
fremennik/compliment: That hat says you stood with the barbarians against the Penance, good.
kid/compliment: Does a barbarian hat mean you have to do a barbarian roar?

remark: Is that skirt cloth at all? It's an odd colour for cloth.
rough/insult: Nice skirt. Very swishy, and very brave an' all.
kid/remark: You've got a skirt on! Are you going to a party?

remark: A mask? What do you know about the air round here that I don't?
insult: Is it my breath? You can just say if it's my breath.
kid/remark: Bzzzzz! You look like a big fly so you have to do the buzzing!

remark: Dressed as a mourner. Off to West Ardougne, are we?
plain/insult: Mourner's clothes? You'll be a cheerful sort, like the rest of them.
kid/insult: Why do you look like a crow that's lost its mum?

remark: Funny shield, that. Looks like it came out of a workshop.
dwarf/compliment: Elemental metal took some smithing, so good on you.
kid/remark: What's the picture on your shield meant to be?

remark: Is that a whole big cat you're wearing?
nan/compliment: Lovely warm furs, dear. You'll not catch a chill in those.
kid/compliment: You're a tiger! Do the roar and make it a big one!

remark: Dressed to blend in somewhere. It isn't here, I'm afraid.
insult: Camouflage in the middle of town, and it very nearly worked, eh?
kid/remark: I can still see you! You're not very good at hiding.

remark: Funny robes. Like something off an island nobody visits.
moon_clan/remark: Our robes, on an outsider. Mind you keep them clean.
kid/remark: You look like a witch, but one of the nice ones I think.

wizard/compliment: Enchanted robes. You've been at the training arena, I see.
toff/remark: Splendid robes. Rather loud, but splendid.
kid/remark: You're all sparkly! Are you a real wizard?

remark: Is that frog you're wearing? Of all the things in the world, frog.
plain/insult: Frog leather. Smells a bit of pond, if I'm honest.
kid/compliment: You're wearing frogs! Can you jump really high now?

remark: Sailor's togs! Which boat are you off, then?
pirate/compliment: Arr, smart coat, matey. Ye'd make a fine first mate.
kid/compliment: If you're a sailor, where's your ship and can I go on it?

remark: Black robes, very gloomy. Been somewhere with a lot of ghosts?
vicar/compliment: Plain dark robes and no fuss, which is humble, and I approve.
kid/insult: You look like a shadow! Go away, shadow, and don't come back!

compliment: Very smart armour, very shiny, and not a dent on it, mind.
toff/compliment: Now that is armour fit for a portrait, citizen.
kid/compliment: You look like a knight out of a story!

remark: Wearing your colours, I see. Saradomin or Zamorak, is it?
vicar/remark: Team colours. I trust you picked the right god.
kid/remark: Are you red team or blue team? I'm blue, so you'd better be.

vicar/insult: Skulls on your cape. I shall pray for you.
guard/remark: Skulls on the cape, eh? I'll be keeping my eye on you.
kid/compliment: Are the skulls real, and can I have one for my room?

compliment: Varrock's colours on your chest, eh? The city thanks you for it.
guard/compliment: Varrock armour. You've done the city a good turn, then.
kid/compliment: Your armour's got Varrock on it and I live in Varrock!

remark: Is that a lamp on your head? Expecting a dark evening?
gnome/compliment: Kandarin headgear! You've been busy in our part of the world.
kid/remark: Does the light on your hat work in the dark, or just here?

remark: Those legs have a touch of the swamp about them.
vicar/compliment: Bless you for the good work you've done in Morytania.
kid/insult: Your trousers look like they've been in a bog.

remark: A knobbly old stick. Walking far, are we?
wizard/remark: Dramen wood. You've been somewhere you shouldn't, I suspect.
kid/insult: That's just a stick. I've got loads of sticks.

compliment: That sword looks like it belongs in a lake... or a legend, maybe.
toff/compliment: A blade fit for a king of the Round Table, I'd say.
kid/compliment: Did you really pull that sword out of a stone like in the story?

remark: You've got rats on a stick. Why have you got rats on a stick?
barkeep/insult: Not in here with those rats, thank you. Leave them out in the yard.
kid/compliment: Rats on a stick! Can I have one, just a little one off the end?

compliment: Gold and jewels on a stick. You've robbed a tomb, haven't you?
shady/compliment: Pharaoh's gold. I'd ask where from, but I know where from.
vicar/insult: Gold from a tomb. The dead do not forget, you know.
kid/compliment: Are you a king, with a stick made of gold like that?

remark: There's a bear on your head. Did the bear agree to that?
fremennik/compliment: A bear's head for a helm? I hope it was well earned.
kid/remark: Does it hurt, having a bear eat your head?

remark: A jester! Go on then, make me laugh while I've got the time.
insult: Bells on your hat. We'll hear you coming, at least.
toff/remark: A fool in motley. Every court should have one.
kid/compliment: Jingle jingle! Do a cartwheel and then a funny walk!

remark: Shayzien colours. Off to fight lizardmen, are we?
guard/compliment: Shayzien kit. Proper soldier's armour, that.
kid/remark: Was the lizard man slimy when you fought him?

remark: A square shield. Not a corner wasted.
dwarf/compliment: Rune square shield. Plain and sturdy, the way it should be.
kid/remark: Your shield's a square and mine's a pan lid, swap?

compliment: Gleaming white armour. A White Knight, are you?
shady/insult: White Knight. All shine on the outside, your sort.
vicar/compliment: White Knights' colours, and Saradomin smile on you for wearing them.
kid/compliment: You're so shiny! Are you a real knight?

compliment: A champion's cape! Beaten the lot of them, have you?
rough/compliment: Champion's colours, eh? Not many wear those, fair play to ye.
kid/compliment: Are you the champion of everything, of the whole world?

remark: A black mask. Should I be holding on to my purse?
guard/remark: Masked, are we? I've got my eye on you, mask or no.
Masked, are we? I'll be keeping an eye on you.
plain/insult: Black mask. Hiding from someone, or from a mirror?
kid/compliment: You look like a villain! One of the good villains, obviously.
shady/compliment: Nice mask, very discreet. We should talk sometime, the two of us.
kid/remark: Are you a robber? You look like a robber!
slayer_master/remark: A black mask. Somebody's been down in the caves.
heartland/remark: A black mask in broad daylight is very mysterious, that.

remark: Dressed for something nasty, by the look of your head.
insult: Forgive me, but you look like you've lost a wager.
rough/remark: Whatever you're off to fight, I don't want to smell it.
kid/insult: You look silly! What's that on your face for?
slayer_master/compliment: Good. You listened about the protective gear.

compliment: A tall hat like that, you must be someone in the temple.
vicar/insult: Does the temple know an adventurer's wearing a bishop's hat?
sharp/insult: Mind the doorframes in that hat, your holiness.
kid/remark: Your hat's ever so tall! Is your head that shape?

remark: Is that a halo? I'll be the judge of that, thank you.
vicar/insult: A halo is earned, friend, not worn on a whim.
plain/insult: A halo, on you? Somebody's having us on.
kid/compliment: If that halo means you're an angel, can you fly?
compliment: A halo! You must be better behaved than you look.
insult: A halo? On you? Somebody's been generous.
vicar/remark: A halo, is it? I'll be the judge of that.
nan/compliment: A halo! What a good child you must have been, dear.
kid/remark: Is that ring over your head floating or is it on a string?

compliment: What a hat! All you need now is a duel to fight.
toff/compliment: A proper cavalier. One almost takes you for a gentleman.
insult: That's a lot of feather for one head, if you don't mind.
kid/remark: Where's the rest of the bird that feather came off?

remark: A green cap with a feather. Off to rob the rich, are we?
toff/insult: That hat. Keep well away from my purse, citizen.
insult: Fine feather. Shame about the rest of the outfit.
kid/compliment: If you're an outlaw, can you shoot an apple off something?

remark: Do take that dragon head off indoors, it gave me a turn.
insult: A dragon's face. An improvement, if I may say so.
rough/remark: Blimey! Thought a dragon had got into the village.
kid/compliment: You're a dragon! Breathe fire at something and show me!

remark: Does that tall green hat with the buckle mean you're feeling lucky?
trader/remark: Lucky hat, is it? Then you can afford my prices, friend.
plain/insult: Lucky hat? Your luck's not reached the rest of you.
kid/remark: Can I have some of your pot of gold, just a handful?
leprechaun/remark: Where'd ye get that hat? That's one of ours, so it is.

compliment: Fine vestments. Off to lead a service, are we?
vicar/compliment: Robes of the faith. Blessings on you, traveller.
shady/insult: Dressed for the temple, how dreadfully devout of you.
kid/remark: Are you a priest? You don't look old enough.

compliment: Very smart. Off somewhere nice, are we?
toff/compliment: Decent tailoring at last. I'd almost have you to dinner.
plain/insult: All dressed up, and nowhere better to be than here.
kid/insult: Is it your wedding you're dressed for, or somebody's funeral?

remark: How humble is gold trim on a monk's robes, exactly?
vicar/insult: Gilding a habit, friend, is vanity in sackcloth.
compliment: Ooh, somebody's trimmed those robes lovely and tidy!
kid/remark: Monks are poor. Why are your robes all gold?

remark: Bark armour. Mind no woodpeckers take a fancy to you.
wizard/compliment: Grown, not forged. There's magic in that bark.
insult: Do pardon me, but you look rather like a hedge.
kid/insult: Can I knock on you, since you're made of wood?

remark: Very solemn robes. Been somewhere gloomy, have you?
vicar/remark: Temple robes from the dark lands, so you've been busy over there.
plain/insult: Have you come from a funeral in those robes, or dressed for your own?
kid/remark: Are you sad, or is your face just like that?

remark: Those robes look like they hold secret meetings.
Dark robes. Very dark. Joined a cult, have you?
shady/compliment: That's the cut of a true believer, so welcome aboard.
Dagon'hai robes. Wear them with pride, friend.
vicar/insult: Robes like those, friend? Then I shall pray for you, and hard.
Those robes have a whiff of Zamorak about them.
kid/remark: Is it fun being a dark wizard, or just dark?
You look like a scary monk!
wizard/remark: The Dagon'hai were turned out for a reason, you know.

remark: Is that armour, or have you strapped a wall to yourself?
Hang on. Is that armour made of actual stone?
dwarf/compliment: Good honest stone. A dwarf could live in that.
Granite! Now there's a sensible material.
plain/insult: Mind the floorboards, if you're going to wear a whole quarry about.
kid/remark: Are you a statue that's learned to walk?
insult: Stone armour. You'll sink like one, mind.
kid/insult: You're wearing rocks. Why are you wearing rocks?

remark: Picked a side, have you, with a cloak in a god's colours?
Very loyal, wearing your god on your cloak like that.
vicar/compliment: Good for you, friend, wearing your faith on your back like that.
shady/insult: Wrong god on that cloak, so do watch yourself.
kid/compliment: Your cloak's got a picture on it and it's so swishy!
insult: Bit of a show-off, a cloak in your god's colours, eh?
vicar/remark: Which god is that cloak for? I can never keep track of the colours.
kid/remark: Is that a flag? Why are you wearing a flag?

compliment: Where are you off to with a proper explorer's pack like that?
insult: Packed for a long journey, and you're still in town.
trader/remark: Room in that pack for a few bargains, my friend?
kid/remark: What's in your bag? Have you got snacks?

remark: That shield looks like a lump of the volcano.
A shield made of black glass? Do try not to drop it near me.
tzhaar/compliment: Good shield, JalYt. You carry it with honour.
Good obsidian, JalYt. You carry it well.
dwarf/compliment: I'll bet that's heavy, volcanic glass shaped proper like that.
kid/remark: Is your shield a rock? It's all black and shiny like one.
insult: Spikes on a shield. Bit much, isn't it?
kid/compliment: Spiky shield! Can I touch the spikes?

remark: Reading that book while you walk? You'll go over in the cart ruts.
wizard/compliment: Ah, a scholar. Carry it open, it impresses people.
wizard/insult: Holding a book is not the same as reading it.
kid/insult: Why would anyone bring their homework outside with them?

remark: Devout sort, eh, with that holy book on your arm?
Reading while you walk? You'll walk into something.
vicar/compliment: Scripture at the ready. Gods smile on you, friend.
A holy book! Bless you, traveller, and do read it, not just carry it.
plain/insult: Carrying a holy book doesn't make you holy, mind.
kid/remark: Will you read me a story out of that book, a short one with a dragon?
insult: Carrying a holy book doesn't make you holy, you know.
wizard/remark: Scripture in the shield hand is a novel defence, if nothing else.
kid/insult: Books are boring. Why'd you bring a book?

remark: I can see myself in that shield, which I expect is the idea.
nan/compliment: Oh, how handy, dear. I can check my hair in that.
plain/insult: Is the mirror shield because you're vain, or just clever?
kid/compliment: I can see my face in your shield! Look at the face I'm pulling!

compliment: Done Falador proud with its colours on your shield, haven't you?
guard/remark: Falador shield, eh? Don't go waving it in here.
toff/insult: A Falador shield. How terribly provincial.
kid/compliment: Are you a white knight? You've got their shield!

remark: Nasty-looking shield. Where in the world was that made?
That shield looks like it was forged in a temper.
vicar/insult: Put that shield away, friend, for it reeks of old evil.
I don't care for that shield, friend, as it feels unwholesome.
shady/compliment: Now that's a shield with a proper history.
I rather like that evil-looking ward of yours.
kid/remark: Has your shield got a face? It looks ever so angry at me.
Why's your shield angry? What did I ever do to it?

remark: Why's the face on that shield looking at me?
ogre/compliment: Ogre shield! You fight like ogre now. Good.
insult: Forgive me, but your shield's prettier than you are.
kid/insult: Your shield's pulling a face at me! Make it stop it right now!

remark: Blade shaped like a leaf. Pretty, for something sharp.
guard/remark: Funny-shaped blade. Keep it sheathed in town.
plain/insult: Leaf-shaped. Off to prune something, are we?
kid/remark: Your sword's a leaf! Can you chop a tree with it?

compliment: A god's staff. That's no ordinary walking stick.
wizard/compliment: Earned in the arena, that. I'll grant you some respect.
vicar/remark: Wield that staff wisely, friend, for the gods do keep watch.
kid/remark: Do a spell with your magic stick, a big one, a loud one!

compliment: Dragon metal on a working tool? Now that's a proper trade.
dwarf/compliment: Fine dragon steel, that. I'd mine with it all day.
rough/remark: A red tool like that? Someone's serious about their work.
kid/remark: Your tool's red! Does it go faster?

compliment: That blade looks like it's seen off a demon or two.
vicar/compliment: A holy blade against the dark, and Saradomin smile on you for it.
guard/remark: Odd glint on that sword. Keep it pointed at demons.
kid/compliment: Your sword's glowing! Have you killed a demon?

remark: A wavy dagger. Someone forged that in a hurry, or on purpose.
guard/remark: Keep that twisty knife of yours out of sight.
plain/insult: Bent dagger. Did you sit on it?
kid/remark: Is your knife broken, or is it meant to be all wiggly?

remark: Where did you find that staff? It gives me a chill just looking.
vicar/insult: Dark wood and a darker past in that staff, friend, so do burn it.
wizard/remark: Careful with that staff, there's a foul name behind it.
kid/insult: Is your stick cursed, or are you, or is it both of you?

remark: Well I never. An anchor... as a weapon?
pirate/compliment: Arr, a proper anchor! Ye'll never drift off course.
guard/remark: An anchor. In town. I don't even have a rule for that.
kid/compliment: Did the ship that goes with that anchor sink or what?

compliment: That wand looks older than the Wizards' Tower.
That wand hums. I can hear it from here.
remark: Odd little wand. It feels like it's watching me.
wizard/insult: A wand that fine, and you wave it about like a ladle.
kid/remark: Can you turn my brother into a newt with that wand, please?
Turn me into a frog with that wand! Only for a bit and I'll come back!
wizard/compliment: A wand of the old Kourend sort. I'd trade my beard for it.

compliment: There's a dragon's look about that lance, which seems only fitting.
Is that lance for dragons? Brave work or daft work, that is.
insult: A lance and no horse. Where did you leave it?
guard/remark: Long lance, that. Keep it pointed at the sky, please.
kid/compliment: Have you killed a big dragon with that lance, or only little ones?
Did the dragon cry when you poked it with that lance?
remark: Isn't a dragon's head on a dragon-hunting lance a bit on the nose?
guard/insult: No jousting in the square. I don't care whose lance it is.

remark: That knife looks like it grew rather than got forged.
insult: Is that dagger breathing? Tell me it isn't breathing.
guard/remark: Keep that knife sheathed while you're in town.
kid/insult: Why does your knife look like a slug that's gone sharp?

compliment: Now that's a sceptre. Very old, very grand.
shady/compliment: You have taste, a sceptre of the old empire.
wizard/remark: That sceptre's Zarosian if I'm any judge, so keep it out of sight.
An old Zarosian sceptre. Some magic ought to stay buried.
vicar/insult: I'd not carry that stick near a chapel, traveller.
I'd not carry that sceptre past a chapel, traveller.
kid/remark: If that's a king's stick, where's your crown?
remark: That sceptre looks older than the town. Older than the hill, even.
kid/compliment: Are you a king? You've got a king stick!

remark: Your tool's on fire. I thought you ought to know.
insult: My hat's flammable, so mind where you swing that flaming tool.
rough/compliment: I'll give it this, a tool that burns as it works saves on kindling.
tzhaar/remark: Made in the fire of the Inferno, JalYt. Do not waste it.
kid/compliment: Doesn't it hurt, holding tools that are on fire like that?

insult: Please tell me that halberd isn't an actual spider's leg.
remark: That blade's dripping. I'd rather not know with what.
Is that halberd made of spider? I can see the legs on it, look.
guard/remark: Long weapon, that. Mind the lanterns.
kid/remark: Is that made of spider? It's got spider bits on!
nan/remark: Spider bits on a pole, dear? I shan't sleep a wink tonight.
kid/compliment: Can I hold the spider sword? I hardly ever drop things.

remark: You throw that ring and it comes back on its own? Whatever next...
insult: Throw that in town and I'll not be the one catching it.
guard/remark: Put those throwing things away, as nothing gets thrown in this city.
kid/compliment: Throw it! Throw it at the pigeons!

compliment: Lovely work on that thrower, dark as a moon gone out.
insult: Whatever next, a stick for throwing other sticks?
remark: A spear-thrower. You don't see those outside Varlamore.
kid/remark: What's that stick for? Do you throw the stick?

remark: Two clubs full of glass teeth, and I'd rather be you than them.
Two clubs with teeth in them? Is one not enough for you?
insult: Two clubs? Couldn't you decide which one you liked?
guard/remark: One club's a weapon, two's a statement, so move along.
kid/compliment: Two of them! I'd want two of them as well!
Two clubs with teeth in! Can you do a spin with them, a fast one?
guard/insult: Two clubs and one pair of hands? Put one of them down at least.

compliment: That's a proper wicked-looking bow, and no mistake.
remark: That bow's darker than a bow has any right to be.
shady/compliment: A fine dark bow. Your sort usually makes do with oak.
guard/remark: Unstring that bow while you're in town, please.
kid/insult: Your bow's gone mouldy. You should give it a wash.

remark: Is that wavy-bladed spear desert work?
Did that spear's blade come out wrong, or is it meant to be wavy?
insult: A wiggly spear. Did it melt in the sun?
trader/compliment: Desert steel, my friend! Worth a pretty penny, that.
kid/remark: Your spear's all squiggly!
Did you sit on your spear or is it meant to be that wobbly?
compliment: A wavy desert spear for beetles? They must be sizeable beetles.
guard/insult: This is a town, so put the wiggly spear away, please.

compliment: Serpent hide, is it? Lovely shimmer on it, whatever it was.
insult: Do you shed, in armour as scaly as that?
remark: Brave tailor, whoever cut that hide off the Varlamore serpent.
trader/compliment: Real serpent hide, that. Nobody can fake that colour.
kid/compliment: You look like a snake, but a nice one that doesn't bite.

remark: Are those moonish robes from Lunar Isle?
moon_clan/compliment: You wear our clan's robes well, traveller.
wizard/insult: Moon robes. Dream magic. Not proper magic at all.
fremennik/insult: Moon Clan robes, outerlander, when they have hexed our boats?
kid/compliment: Ooh, your clothes have got moons on, loads of moons!

item.pattern: (?:^(Statius's|Vesta's|Morrigan's|Zuriel's) )|(?:^(Vesta's (chainbody|plateskirt)|Statius's (full helm|platebody|platelegs)|Zuriel's (hood|robe top|robe bottom)|Morrigan's (coif|leather body|leather chaps)))|(?:^(Vesta's (longsword|spear|blighted longsword)|Statius's warhammer|Zuriel's staff|Morrigan's (javelin|throwing axe)))

compliment: Where did you find armour from the old wars, in this day and age?
Armour from the old wars, that. I thought it had all crumbled.
remark: Gear like that comes out of the Wilderness, or nowhere.
Didn't that armour belong to someone famous and long dead?
An old warrior's weapon. They say those crumble in the end.
shady/compliment: Wilderness spoils. You don't flinch, do you?
dwarf/compliment: Nobody's forged weapons as lovely as that since the God Wars.
kid/remark: You look like a statue in the square!
That armour's from a story, a really old one with ghosts in!
guard/insult: That's an ancient warrior's weapon. Wilderness stock, I'll bet.
shady/remark: How did you get that weapon out of the Wilderness and keep breathing?
kid/compliment: Did you win that off a ghost, a really old one with a beard?

remark: That book looks like it'd bite if you opened it.
insult: A book in a fight. Will you bore them to death?
wizard/compliment: An elemental tome! The Tower has nothing so fine.
kid/remark: Read a spell out of that book, go on, a proper one!

compliment: That's the Myths' Guild cape. You've done something big.
insult: A guild cape. They'll let anyone in these days.
toff/remark: The Myths' Guild. Rather exclusive, one hears.
kid/compliment: Are you a hero, with a cape as fancy as that?

remark: Is that a shell on your back, and do you hide in it?
insult: You look like a tortoise in a hurry.
pirate/remark: A tortugan shell, eh? Gryphon waters, them.
kid/compliment: You're a turtle! Can you go in your shell?

compliment: Gold and blue, that shield. Desert work, and none of it cheap.
insult: A shield that shiny. You'll dazzle the thing you're fighting.
vicar/remark: A ward blessed by desert gods, and Saradomin won't mind... probably.
kid/compliment: Is your shield real gold? Can I bite it to check like Dad does?

compliment: Robes like that, a wizard would trade his tower for.
remark: Was it on purpose, your robes going all twisty like that?
wizard/insult: Twisted robes, twisted hat. One does wonder about the wearer.
kid/remark: Your hat's all curly at the top like a snail's house!

compliment: Blood-red armour. You look like the last thing a knight sees.
